Bill grew up in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and is a proud LSU graduate. He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility.
As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act.
Bill, and his wife, Laura, live in Baton Rouge and attend church at the Chapel on the Campus. They are blessed with three children and one grandchild.

name: =?utf-8?Q?Jim=20Walsh?=
subject: Voting in-person for WA Republicans
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Washington State Republican Party
body:
Republicans across the state are leading the charge are bringing back voting in-person to Washington State. You can help support these efforts. | | | [ ](https://wsrp.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be1a8605f1118163852707f35&id=8047acddb5&e=6a281f566d)
---
| | Dear Peter,

For decades, Republicans have been asking to vote in-person again in Washington State. **Now you can.**

Republicans have also been worried about whether or not returning a ballot through the Post Office is trustworthy. **Now you don't have to worry about it.**

Over the last month, the Washington State Republican Party has launched a program called**'Secure Your Vote'. **

This program includes several steps that encourages Republicans to vote, promotes legal ballot harvesting, and **helps ensure that every vote is properly counted** at the county elections office.

We are aligned with local businesses, churches, fishing & wildlife shops and conservative leaning groups to organize **conservative ballot box centers **across the state. We are also establishing **grassroots conservative teams** who will help you verify that your ballot was returned and counted by the county elections.

Building the statewide infrastructure for**'Secure Your Vote'** is going to take a lot of grassroots power and resources.**The secure ballot boxes alone can cost up to $150 each - these aren't just a shoe box with a whole cut in it.** And they are accompanied with voter information & materials, ballot tracking, and trained grassroots volunteer teams.

Our first step is to train the grassroots conservative teams and to establish the secure ballot boxes. While we start with training, can you help us put in place more secure ballot boxes?

**With your support, we can hit our goal of 200 verified conservative ballot box centers before the 2024 statewide election.** That's $30,000 just for the secure ballot boxes alone, which we've already spent $4,000 of.

[_**Can you help us reach the last $26,000 with a grassroots contribution of $10, $25, or $50 today?**_](https://wsrp.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be1a8605f1118163852707f35&id=137390371f&e=6a281f566d)

---
| [Help fund conservative ballot box centers](https://wsrp.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be1a8605f1118163852707f35&id=18cf7fe2ae&e=6a281f566d "Help fund conservative ballot box centers")
---
| Grassroots conservatives are already hard at work in all 39 counties and**here are some of the success stories** so far:

\- 9 conservative ballot boxes in Pierce county with 8 more on the way.

\- 3 In-person voting events organized in Central WA with 8 ballot boxes being deployed this week.

\- 15 churches have established conservative ballot box centers with hundreds of pastors encouraging voting within their congregations.

\- tens-of-thousands of phone calls and text messages are being launched to conservative voters for the 2023 local elections to connect them with our trained and verified grassroots volunteers.

Not every county and district has a fully operational ballot box center yet, or a team of trained and verified grassroots conservatives helping voters secure their vote. We will keep growing. And continue building. **And with your support, by next year we can hit our goal of 200 verified conservative ballot box centers in Washington State.**
---
| [Help fund conservative ballot box centers](https://wsrp.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be1a8605f1118163852707f35&id=04d8ed87fb&e=6a281f566d "Help fund conservative ballot box centers")
---
|
---
| | **Ballot harvesting is legal in Washington State. **Democrats have already been doing it in the shadows to win elections for the last decade.

Republicans in Washington State must start the effort now if we want to win close races for the foreseeable future. We will do it as aggressively as possible. We will conduct our efforts legally and with integrity. And in doing so, **we will start winning again!**

Please support our efforts today to bring this important change to the way our Party operates campaigns. Thank you!

Sincerely,

Jim Walsh
Chairman
Washington State Republican Party

name: Al Franken
subject: the hard way
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| Running for office is tough. You have to ask a bunch of people for money (like this), and then the other side gets together and says lots of mean things about you.

Having a baby is tough, too. There’s lots of screaming and crying, poop gets everywhere, and you don’t get any sleep. Now that I think about it, it’s a lot like running for office...

Team, I’m writing because my friend and former Senate counsel Josh Riley is doing BOTH. First, I laughed and told him he was crazy. When I realized he wasn’t joking, I said I’d help!

[**Josh is running for Congress in NY-19, and his race could decide the House majority. Will you join me and split a contribution between Josh Riley and the Voter Protection Project today to help him win one of the most important races in the country?**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/54692?t=6&akid=11104%2E878179%2ESVqign)

Josh is used to doing things the hard way.

He grew up in the district in a working-class neighborhood in Endicott, NY. When the local factories closed, Josh saw his community struggle – but he worked to put himself through school and graduated from Harvard Law.

In the Senate, Josh and I brought Republicans and Democrats together to actually get stuff done (yes, it really is possible)! The bills we worked on together expanded rights for survivors of domestic abuse and provided new funding for addiction treatment and mental health programs. It wasn’t easy, but Josh got them signed into law.

**Now, Josh is running for Congress without taking any corporate PAC money. He knows it’s not the easy route, but it’s the right thing to do.**

But that means he’s relying on folks like you and me chipping in. And with his time spread thin between the campaign, the new baby and, ya know, still having time to breathe, he’s relying on us now more than ever.

[**So if you can, please split a contribution between the Voter Protection Project and Josh’s campaign today. Josh’s race will be one of the most competitive in the entire country, and he’ll win it with our help.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/54692?t=7&akid=11104%2E878179%2ESVqign) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Josh Riley and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/54693?t=8&akid=11104%2E878179%2ESVqign)

Thanks,

Al

* * *

With food prices at an all-time high and the recent expiration of expanded pandemic food assistance, the last thing lawmakers should be doing is making it harder for struggling families to eat, yet _[Republicans want to cut the program further as the government funding fight looms.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDFPZEzZ6wEhLpaimocMRJcTVmQ78mVPSosGQrqoCDbXoIWuZxEST3RYmVx4SVwoQj8ZjjdgJL4LzHunAYtnUq74E9lMUpefz1tduB23zrDRnEWcwHlpdtfbPNvRvRMz1DsO7EzYStnxMHiU3eSTMdF0geEh5vJgXm1adQMAnNCCskp5xeu04K0clCjq-QD8CELRKsPK1d-zSbdiCjvQS25RM2klDVYE0jLXaFuL3JOdavlH4_LenIb-ezCglW_2asP2WdSfyMqcrDohn7wzIaLpAcZQy9eiFIXDsclkbsuyRlyAPORSGmYyGrROLHAAZpu9JvHRw0IdB2jrz1q7_0JE/40c/nE_YstbHRzOHnAb39pASvA/h1/fBVmHXfAE2eXB6Hx1MjfT0ivohdIJmPPcY1z4cIJfr8)_

The Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), often called food stamps or SNAP, plays a vital role in providing nutritious food to households experiencing food insecurity.

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

name: Nikki Haley
subject: I’m an outsider
body:
Why I took on the political establishment

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zr7vqeaf2mpo7j4691jok5tvmsim17l4spqus0cg_rp22sh2s8i66p77c1i61ob5clh2bs)
---

Friend,

Growing up, I never thought of a life in politics. It was a world I knew nothing about and didn't care about.

>From what I could see, politicians were people on TV who claimed to be working for us but too often seemed to be busy promoting themselves.

Instead, I thought I would have a future in business. I always loved numbers, and in the world of business, numbers tell stories that are fascinating to me.

That's how I got my start. When I was 13, I started doing the books at my mom's store. When I returned to our family business, after earning an accounting degree, I learned how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for the government to take it away.

My mom told me not to complain but do something about it.

So, I did.

---
| | [JOIN MY TEAM](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zlv1ob9t4cf75ufe5boh2j5a2pdejgfeafsntip0_rp22sh2s8i66p77c1i61ob5clh2bs)
---

That's when I ran for state legislature. I didn't know that you weren't supposed to run against a 30-year incumbent. But being the underdog didn't matter to me. I wanted to fight to make a difference.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z1v0dcglal4pdbqrq4iiu49mhgoc05fvms55m1vo_rp22sh2s8i66p77c1i61ob5clh2bs)
---

So, I reached out to every person I could. I told them why I wanted to work for them. I won. I immediately got to work. I fought for government transparency, stood up to reckless spending, and worked for the people of my district.

Then I ran for governor. I was the underdog once again, but I fought and won. I challenged the status quo in the state house and as governor and fought for legislation that would make a difference, from transparency in government and voter ID laws, to strengthening the economy and championing education.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z58mseg34sjvejvlv0qed2maiffgdq4imbkpb1ho_rp22sh2s8i66p77c1i61ob5clh2bs)
---

I've worn many hats throughout my life. I'm an accountant, the mom of two, a proud wife of a combat veteran, the daughter of immigrants who came here legally, and a strong conservative. I've served as governor and UN Ambassador.

Most importantly, I'm a proud American who knows our best days are yet to come if we unite to save our country. **[Will you join me in this fight?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zsud9k28pjr8662v8j63kvce0ohekembkffda688_rp22sh2s8i66p77c1i61ob5clh2bs "Will you join me in this fight?")**

---
| | [JOIN MY TEAM](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zant3miamebfucpc0p6na1usj43n446q3ktacceo_rp22sh2s8i66p77c1i61ob5clh2bs)
---

I'm running for president because I know Americans deserve better. It's time for a new generation of leadership to come in, step up, and reverse the damage that's been created.

Winning is only possible with a strong team of grassroots supporters by my side. If you have even $5 to spare, it will make an important difference. **[Will you chip in just $5 or more today to help me win this fight for our nation's future?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3lp9nrtr6ohscsgbvejjo0o6d15lci9h5ih0kh0_rp22sh2s8i66p77c1i61ob5clh2bs "Will you chip in just $5 or more today to help me win this fight for our nation’s future?")**

---
My very best,
---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z1r5aoeafpoqfuedfuqacvk6oheepm2pfug0e0to_rp22sh2s8i66p77c1i61ob5clh2bs)

Nikki Haley
---

| | [GET YOUR HAT NOW](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7fir9o58re2k8l4qp9l7han3hlp05fteebjgjn0_rp22sh2s8i66p77c1i61ob5clh2bs "Claim Your Mug")
---
---
| | **More About Nikki Haley**

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7k2jc64ssr7td7tj9ni5419m15i9576dkm93bhg_rp22sh2s8i66p77c1i61ob5clh2bs "NikkiHaley_Podium")
---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhqv42iu2tt08h7cbvi5t2ughkga1c9ic1q40ak0_rp22sh2s8i66p77c1i61ob5clh2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

---

Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. ## **Biden Addresses Nation on Israel Conflict **
Yesterday, President Biden took the podium to address the nation on the escalating situation between Israel and Hamas. In his speech, Biden expressed that the U.S. "has Israel's back" as the country prepares for intense conflict within the Gaza Strip.

Afterward, [the President took heat](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00L1yhCAUQOGnwQ6HH1EpKLax27QpHZDrehMEBsiafftM0qc-zZnv_b7eLQaMjzd7gml7Wu3W8AkrZ5RzKuRtHTpvdgABsgPDRz0xoZkYusO4aRqsVLNw2lsnNdsn7uzItR7UDJp1aAQTkjPOmVZKzr1nViuh3MgFZ7PSZGDgsaXSfySM7YA9vNITSr-lswvmaC1XIm9ELEQs13X1e_qOcNXfTsSSU8CGWyVicegh0oI5g6cxNXpCbJgixgfFYiOtGWA7KNZiIdDDnrbSr9aghBfFUqDmFCu6APQC-9kV4_OFIWAdJzKwx2kx_F21f5R-AgAA__-e_2vw) for not calling out Iran as a major contributor to Saturday's unprecedented attacks. This latest tragedy adds to the immense pressures that [some believe Biden is having difficulty addressing](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LFugzAQxvGnMRvo7mwcPHjIwpauHZHBR7jIwQisoLx9lUodu3zTJ_2k__dtuAVJst6_wpN9mfMQpiIvHhBqxJr0dTBV9DMzsa7Yo3UXIAdkqsWPaCxPswt80WMw3cSjMTZEsthCp6kST0AaARFc2-quiRBcS-1okRC61ikDHKXkvXlkWcvCc3rnF-_NlJ9V8ksp26H0VVGvqD_Ps9lykiJT_hwU9Sufh6L-oyjqEf7mkbkeJfJaH4VDfNeJQ-T9WGSrAZDAWqh2H7dTUpLDXpSB-zNI-oXLPyF-AgAA__9231vr) as POTUS. With a looming government shutdown and war raging in Eastern Europe, this foreign policy predicament could prove to be his toughest test yet. |
## **Defense Stocks Surge**
Following the unprecedented attacks against Israel at the hands of Hamas, [defense stocks have seen massive gains](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLuO5CAQRb8GZ1hQ-NEEDkZakc2mG1plKDds82gBM1b__ao3n_gG95zz53P_xBBDvv_GRFs_y462h2_apeBSclAf-zS47SQCUgNtctGrAC1gGvx2WFzcgYg3sc4zWiv06dbTWpByOqwawgYClBRSCj3P6jY6gXqG-VgkSHGbNZsEudBLHf-WkLunM77KN9XRljTEzff-bEx9MDAMzHVd41nqQe09MzAtdGoMjKNKj4ZfkYF5HzIwUjAwQjMwsdiHJ3I8Ye0h81xq97U8-b1-pYSZt17so_FcuvX8oNa5w1fjIfMXYW0cU3A8tIoUuceEjduSzxhsf2Mp0zxTv1awSgLpBYUd6uaeV4gxtGVlk7gnDPG_Uf-h8L8AAAD__7IYfXE) across the board. U.S.-listed Lockheed Martin (LMT) and Northrop Grumman (NOC) each gained around 9% following Saturday's attacks and subsequent actions taken by Israel. Across Europe, companies like BAE Systems, Leonardo, and Dassault Aviation gained over 4%. Even [Japanese and South Korean](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvgzAQhX-N2YzOZ5zgwUMWtnTtiA58BCcGI-wE9d9XqdRuXd7ynp4-fZ_X_kohhvX2QQu7MqWexhJe3CuQSknUl76pvJuYkXXFTp3sGdACNtXsNLIH7Um32PoWLZAejG2mAVBbNrYKDgG1AqXAGqPb2gNZg2Y4KVTQGisaYB9K2ut7CmuZeYpf6cV7Paalim4uZctCXwR2ArvjOOpxHcZ3KbB7XwvsFPzGnTZaZU7PMstH2pmk54nXzDKXND6yfG6SpsK7nGmhLKkUGh-Swh7D-jfKMXiu57LEand-O0KMIZ_OooHbQiH-kJV_TH0HAAD__1u8aaU) defense companies, Mitsubishi Heavy Industries and Hosoya Pyro-Engineering, saw spikes in stock prices yesterday. Analysts expect the sector to [rise even higher](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00L9ugzAQgPGngc3ofP4DHjxkYUvXjsixj3CtwRF2U-Xtq3bv_kmf9Hu_LtfAmY_7W9jJt7UsITZ-0iJBSClQXRbdJ78SIamevLRuBHSAut88jqDITeOkQYdojbMmKhe0XadbGmXs2SOgkiAlOGPUNCQIzqC5WYkSJuM6DZS4lXP4KHy0jdb8Kk86h1j2PvuttUft1KXDucN55SMckYZX2Er5LTqcn5yodDgnWumoJGor8bOK-nXeSYSdk-B6BspCalDGwiSHre25P316fHPOXO3YabjvgfPftP2D8BMAAP__Tqtcfw) than its recent $20 billion increase in market cap as the war in the Middle East ramps up.
## Crypto Fraudster Testifies
Caroline Ellison, the ex-CEO of Sam Bankman-Fried's infamous hedge fund, Alameda Research, [testified yesterday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL1uKyEQRp9mt8MaBvaHgsKNO9_2lqsBBpuEBYtFdvL2kdOn_PTpSEfn_3W7Usqp3P7RzrbHupHv6cmbBCGlQHXe9BhsZEZWI1s5mwXQAOrxbrUCpyThIiePKjBE1rQGN8clOtY4JouASoKUYKZJracAZCac3CxRwjqZQQOH1Gs7fdRU-p1j_q5Pbidf9zHbe--PY1DnAS8DXuhR-HW8r_doPfnMA14clc-diogtcRC9JcrCU6s5FRacczpqEbF_icNF4QI5QAWLAvawmEhhZYR19tE4Feex2fB4pTc1L4OG204p_9r0P-r8BAAA__-b52Vn) that the fallen crypto mogul had directed her and her colleagues to defraud customers linked to the doomed FTX crypto exchange. Ellison stated that Alameda Research leveraged about $10 billion in FTX customer funds to cover debts and investments. Customers had no knowledge of this prior to the FTX collapse. Since the 28-year-old executive was not only one of the closest people to the case but also the ex-partner of Sam Bankman-Fried himself, her testimony has been keenly awaited. So far, Bankman-Fried has pleaded not guilty to two counts of fraud and five counts of conspiracy related to the apparent scam, which has been called [this generation's Enron](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LtuwjAUxvGnSTZHx3YSyOCBJRtdO0a-HJMDviDbQPv2Fe3c8ZO-4af_53k7awqULh86omo-b9o2euLGgXHOhDxtY--URxQoe1R8Xg4gFhBjv6uDMZYLOWvv0IP2s7Tu6AFmbvyIi-tJCRCSA-ewTJM8Dg70MonJzFxwOE5LNwI6arkM10yp7ejDd35iGWyOfVB7a_fayVMn1k6sUZcbtjqYR6WEtVKq5P6-nVgTvmonVvsoBZMlfI8rRWZ3nXJlkeyuMbCAL6qs6siMTreoE_OF0DHfvhimkhOrxrM3m3Hoi3L3F4VAdT50I1yipvBra_-0-gkAAP__9UptEQ).

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has _promised_ that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

subject: Your Signature is Needed: Upgrade EVERY public school to be zero-emission
body:
| | | | | [](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2042857?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---|---|---

| | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: Tell Congress to support safe, sustainable public schools and ensure a bright future for our young people! ** Many of our public schools are **underfunded** and **under-resourced.** Students try to learn in crowded classes and outdated buildings – some without working AC. In some cases, students and staff are **regularly exposed to environmental hazards like mold and asbestos.** The good news is that Senator Ed Markey and Representative Jamaal Bowman just re-introduced a bill to change all that: the **Green New Deal for Public Schools Act.** This legislation would provide desperately needed funding to support our students and teachers, including**upgrading every school building in the country to create healthy, zero-carbon and accessible learning environments.** [_**Please, Friend, take just 30 seconds to support our students and staff in public schools. Tell Congress to create jobs and green our schools by passing the Green New Deal for Public Schools Act! >>**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2042858?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION NOW ](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2042859?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Friends of the Earth partnered with the sponsors to ensure that the bill also includes resources for healthy, climate-friendly school meals, including more plant-based school meal options. All students deserve access to nutritious meal options, and more plant-based meals on the menu will **reduce the climate-warming emissions created by industrial meat production** that are putting young people’s futures in peril.
The Green New Deal for Public Schools Act will fund **millions of good-paying jobs** in every school district in the country. It’s past time we rebuild our schools and fully invest in the next generation. [_**Will you send your message to Congress and fight for green, safe schools for our nation’s students?**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2042860?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. subject: I’m an outsider
body:
Why I took on the political establishment

| |
---
| | | | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=172a14d2610c42ad8f1e7a45aee334ac&_e=PZTvt8LDENA3Ct9ixLtaxU_MmN3IL_075FKJ5qyqDhv_BytqdUisTImpvx_eqcWplZ1ya8l488iDJjvIOchmNpfSkQABdPLdoKo54_Av00cdgBqb5WEXbLuUttEh0kjMB7j34Ra5nnaLRc6OgYbaIvCdWF2HBmhNcBHwWpSu-rtrjoJbRpqeD5E3Kc3MIYudAv37zxmyvKw0kt9auxqvmSXoF8LuyCabQILQn-AsgrOTQ9BRnnDrILJZFLGbwmOBmO9NEPnJcTIFCq1gUZlUCSF54O8q_K6NwHWgGaHRbeQaROr_vO4B1wjyPGDFmfpV91VexjQpA_iRbEwot9BUfxZZB1jBKr5eqwiTaDGDTdcPTQSr318LN9dDr-EFw8S6A03RYqIaUaIivhkky3kR_m-xN9Pw3WXspdDj3i7N_n-oFgERXbD608nHrJAT8ucBNN3-0eUQmlTiHgvaUzITdw7OnF6CS6IRgJc_C6bFcAREG-KVhQirlVd_jtrpse06__rgRQMw9hion4sOTikOueoGsrHOSdkoote-G680faFxelE5zgBaLSi2WpSvRvicnCVtPGIqyu91Jes72nlr2LM_qB_UEhWNa1Rq63kEHgp4xYiD65vgqOgkdE-ioafl)
---

Friend,

Growing up, I never thought of a life in politics. It was a world I knew nothing about and didn't care about.

From what I could see, politicians were people on TV who claimed to be working for us but too often seemed to be busy promoting themselves.

Instead, I thought I would have a future in business. I always loved numbers, and in the world of business, numbers tell stories that are fascinating to me.

That's how I got my start. When I was 13, I started doing the books at my mom's store. When I returned to our family business, after earning an accounting degree, I learned how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for the government to take it away.

My mom told me not to complain but do something about it.

So, I did.

---
| | [JOIN MY TEAM](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=172a14d2610c42ad8f1e7a45aee334ac&_e=PZTvt8LDENA3Ct9ixLtaxU_MmN3IL_075FKJ5qyqDhv_BytqdUisTImpvx_eqcWplZ1ya8l488iDJjvIOchmNpfSkQABdPLdoKo54_Av00cdgBqb5WEXbLuUttEh0kjMB7j34Ra5nnaLRc6OgYbaIvCdWF2HBmhNcBHwWpSu-rtrjoJbRpqeD5E3Kc3MIYudAv37zxmyvKw0kt9auxqvmSXoF8LuyCabQILQn-AsgrOTQ9BRnnDrILJZFLGbwmOBmO9NEPnJcTIFCq1gUZlUCSF54O8q_K6NwHWgGaHRbeQaROr_vO4B1wjyPGDFmfpV91VexjQpA_iRbEwot9BUfxZZB1jBKr5eqwiTaDGDTdcPTQSr318LN9dDr-EFw8S6A03RYqIaUaIivhkky3kR_m-xN9Pw3WXspdDj3i7N_n-oFgERXbD608nHrJAT8ucBNN3-0eUQmlTiHgvaUzITdw7OnF6CS6IRgJc_C6bFcAQJ2oNT2jE4GGhdF1fMoZOXXxFXxdrlF1uSoPJjHmFGRJKwbdyJFj3IsFfeSXvtWs2-TPdJHfDOx9asYI97OLpYY4xX_QuEYTXs23EHZ-1CRhf1WbL5NFBux-FL2a3gxI2AHsT16k0V65JITL33Ozlv)
---

That's when I ran for state legislature. I didn't know that you weren't supposed to run against a 30-year incumbent. But being the underdog didn't matter to me. I wanted to fight to make a difference.

---
| [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=172a14d2610c42ad8f1e7a45aee334ac&_e=PZTvt8LDENA3Ct9ixLtaxU_MmN3IL_075FKJ5qyqDhv_BytqdUisTImpvx_eqcWplZ1ya8l488iDJjvIOchmNpfSkQABdPLdoKo54_Av00cdgBqb5WEXbLuUttEh0kjMB7j34Ra5nnaLRc6OgYbaIvCdWF2HBmhNcBHwWpSu-rtrjoJbRpqeD5E3Kc3MIYudAv37zxmyvKw0kt9auxqvmSXoF8LuyCabQILQn-AsgrOTQ9BRnnDrILJZFLGbwmOBmO9NEPnJcTIFCq1gUZlUCSF54O8q_K6NwHWgGaHRbeQaROr_vO4B1wjyPGDFmfpV91VexjQpA_iRbEwot9BUfxZZB1jBKr5eqwiTaDGDTdcPTQSr318LN9dDr-EFw8S6A03RYqIaUaIivhkky3kR_m-xN9Pw3WXspdDj3i7N_n-oFgERXbD608nHrJAT8ucBNN3-0eUQmlTiHgvaUzITdw7OnF6CS6IRgJc_C6bFcAR86G2liR-8TYmF-OHsC-jpst7xk-vtFTJhgarJFXigfhMugSLTA-mgIRc1Nu9kqdEOuNWDQ_Xh77ErwrGipIOTZONGithTZ16CykHrHrIDr00A4_lfIhF7tyyHY0iX7OBiLssBX8lXbX6nvZymQBHk)
---

So, I reached out to every person I could. I told them why I wanted to work for them. I won. I immediately got to work. I fought for government transparency, stood up to reckless spending, and worked for the people of my district.

Then I ran for governor. I was the underdog once again, but I fought and won. I challenged the status quo in the state house and as governor and fought for legislation that would make a difference, from transparency in government and voter ID laws, to strengthening the economy and championing education.

---
| [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=172a14d2610c42ad8f1e7a45aee334ac&_e=PZTvt8LDENA3Ct9ixLtaxU_MmN3IL_075FKJ5qyqDhv_BytqdUisTImpvx_eqcWplZ1ya8l488iDJjvIOchmNpfSkQABdPLdoKo54_Av00cdgBqb5WEXbLuUttEh0kjMB7j34Ra5nnaLRc6OgYbaIvCdWF2HBmhNcBHwWpSu-rtrjoJbRpqeD5E3Kc3MIYudAv37zxmyvKw0kt9auxqvmSXoF8LuyCabQILQn-AsgrOTQ9BRnnDrILJZFLGbwmOBmO9NEPnJcTIFCq1gUZlUCSF54O8q_K6NwHWgGaHRbeQaROr_vO4B1wjyPGDFmfpV91VexjQpA_iRbEwot9BUfxZZB1jBKr5eqwiTaDGDTdcPTQSr318LN9dDr-EFw8S6A03RYqIaUaIivhkky3kR_m-xN9Pw3WXspdDj3i7N_n-oFgERXbD608nHrJAT8ucBNN3-0eUQmlTiHgvaUzITdw7OnF6CS6IRgJc_C6bFcAR0sgPNXlsbQHT3jC2SLjwZpwnZIY5oMkffSr5-W9lIxraJRxO5kQLkaVe8Ujwz0c2Ysz1wXSCUuk2oP0rcPdyYsRxV8zBJgn7KLbiS1aQsXHaUfCPQH_RDKJhRHyLCpl2KKhF4k2y4jCsLZZImjyK6)
---

I've worn many hats throughout my life. I'm an accountant, the mom of two, a proud wife of a combat veteran, the daughter of immigrants who came here legally, and a strong conservative. I've served as governor and UN Ambassador.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

clean_body: Why I took on the political establishment | | | | | | Friend, Growing up, I never thought of a life in politics. It was a world I knew nothing about and didn't care about. From what I could see, politicians were people on TV who claimed to be working for us but too often seemed to be busy promoting themselves. Instead, I thought I would have a future in business. I always loved numbers, and in the world of business, numbers tell stories that are fascinating to me. That's how I got my start. When I was 13, I started doing the books at my mom's store. When I returned to our family business, after earning an accounting degree, I learned how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for the government to take it away. My mom told me not to complain but do something about it. So, I did. | | That's when I ran for state legislature. I didn't know that you weren't supposed to run against a 30-year incumbent. But being the underdog didn't matter to me. I wanted to fight to make a difference. | So, I reached out to every person I could. I told them why I wanted to work for them. I won. I immediately got to work. I fought for government transparency, stood up to reckless spending, and worked for the people of my district. Then I ran for governor. I was the underdog once again, but I fought and won. I challenged the status quo in the state house and as governor and fought for legislation that would make a difference, from transparency in government and voter ID laws, to strengthening the economy and championing education. | I've worn many hats throughout my life. I'm an accountant, the mom of two, a proud wife of a combat veteran, the daughter of immigrants who came here legally, and a strong conservative. I've served as governor and UN Ambassador. Most importantly, I'm a proud American who knows our best days are yet to come if we unite to save our country. "Will you join me in this fight?" | | I'm running for president because I know Americans deserve better. It's time for a new generation of leadership to come in, step up, and reverse the damage that's been created. Winning is only possible with a strong team of grassroots supporters by my side. If you have even $5 to spare, it will make an important difference. "Will you chip in just $5 or more today to help me win this fight for our nation’s future?" My very best, | Nikki Haley | | | | | | | | "NikkiHaleyMerch" | | "Claim Your Mug" | | More About Nikki Haley | "NikkiHaleyPodium" My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States. I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country. I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A. I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor" because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. At the UN I fought for America, made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names. I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. And I 'll do it as your next President. subject: I’m an outsider
body:
Why I took on the political establishment

| |
---
| | | | [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=36083d53f8394446ad7ad5fa9ab78cd9&_e=iJR2ZLZFDyv5rxmFkaN_GhXDgsgqGa6EKZ7hNiZnnDCp6uCQMIahTwBSiwO9Ga_Mqp-6gCHxnTh_htgXC7r4xxusWIkeBKQQcFFE8c0LIJze_7_NMCexfXjSdZ5lXCHZseL_H2SH0SG3aKljqKXbJjcdiLPU_wwHsEyGGWguESGlgpPNNdo0swZGdSPcV45uu_XL69s9_jk_T5CjECshathwabJEHBRAkKnwFoQ4UEn5c8t1NPlNt3EhunIZfB64_kn0cu16JyVDQr8XnQ9fUxwFgdth3gB82uZbSKi3pucC-jzJZOo2evXJiEF2ddHnkItQTp5dWNFKhQBU-XcV6YjaJtOtTgEgzthK5mnpExf_nVyAv7gcnpKYA4HKXL4NScQX2t5ECiHyZVZbMZgn54FFNw4jy2YROF0lU1LIx-YNyDi3wUcWlGFvT8pQY-fe4lAAUSQXBg7c3hdS0Q8AN9ejl0FsqnJ6r09c_9mppRpnrg2qA6uvHnL0l45SQNZA_lYhHg3gXz5Qcu1npgP217IrLm0MGkEDWhHYJGA9hpGlP6DOkW2ndsUaBsE2AYUpPwIiXr6HJ-pWKtxl0Je86xrr2Iasj6UKkkvrgKKe55Gf_5cMDyjd2-B3KMWIQwfy)
---

Friend,

Growing up, I never thought of a life in politics. It was a world I knew nothing about and didn't care about.

From what I could see, politicians were people on TV who claimed to be working for us but too often seemed to be busy promoting themselves.

Instead, I thought I would have a future in business. I always loved numbers, and in the world of business, numbers tell stories that are fascinating to me.

That's how I got my start. When I was 13, I started doing the books at my mom's store. When I returned to our family business, after earning an accounting degree, I learned how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for the government to take it away.

My mom told me not to complain but do something about it.

So, I did.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

clean_body: Why I took on the political establishment | | | | | | Friend, Growing up, I never thought of a life in politics. It was a world I knew nothing about and didn't care about. From what I could see, politicians were people on TV who claimed to be working for us but too often seemed to be busy promoting themselves. Instead, I thought I would have a future in business. I always loved numbers, and in the world of business, numbers tell stories that are fascinating to me. That's how I got my start. When I was 13, I started doing the books at my mom's store. When I returned to our family business, after earning an accounting degree, I learned how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for the government to take it away. My mom told me not to complain but do something about it. So, I did. | | That's when I ran for state legislature. I didn't know that you weren't supposed to run against a 30-year incumbent. But being the underdog didn't matter to me. I wanted to fight to make a difference. | So, I reached out to every person I could. I told them why I wanted to work for them. I won. I immediately got to work. I fought for government transparency, stood up to reckless spending, and worked for the people of my district. Then I ran for governor. I was the underdog once again, but I fought and won. I challenged the status quo in the state house and as governor and fought for legislation that would make a difference, from transparency in government and voter ID laws, to strengthening the economy and championing education. | I've worn many hats throughout my life. I'm an accountant, the mom of two, a proud wife of a combat veteran, the daughter of immigrants who came here legally, and a strong conservative. I've served as governor and UN Ambassador. Most importantly, I'm a proud American who knows our best days are yet to come if we unite to save our country. "Will you join me in this fight?" | | I'm running for president because I know Americans deserve better. It's time for a new generation of leadership to come in, step up, and reverse the damage that's been created. Winning is only possible with a strong team of grassroots supporters by my side. If you have even $5 to spare, it will make an important difference. "Will you chip in just $5 or more today to help me win this fight for our nation’s future?" My very best, | Nikki Haley | | | | | | | | "NikkiHaleyMerch" | | "Claim Your Mug" | | More About Nikki Haley | "NikkiHaleyPodium" My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States. I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country. I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A. I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor" because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. At the UN I fought for America, made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names. I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. And I 'll do it as your next President. And Republicans -- especially vulnerable ones in swing districts -- need to know that if they support an election denier, we will come for them HARD on election day. [**So speak up, don't accept stupidity as the new norm, and tell Republicans NO election deniers for speaker.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc3462710-d26a-42ca-8ee9-d704a3cdf4f2/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

clean_body: Of all the skills of leadership, listening is the most valuable | | Peter, We are Americans. At the end of the day, that is our most unifying principle. That spirit of unity is a centerpiece of my campaign. We cannot establish a national identity without saying, "I am proud to be American." A President can and should be the best example of that ideal. Someone who listens to every American, even if they disagree on issues or on how to make America stronger. That's exactly why I need to hear from you now, Peter. | PRE-DEBATE ISSUES POLL 1\. ◯ Yes ◯ No 2\. ◯ Yes ◯ No ◯ Unsure 3\. ◯ State of the economy ◯ Standing with our allies ◯ Strength of our borders ◯ Big Tech and censorship ◯ Securing our elections ◯ Stance on "Woke" Issues 4\. ◯ Right ◯ Wrong ◯ Unsure 5\. Share your thoughts on how to save America | Thanks, Vivek Ramaswamy GET TO KNOW VIVEK: Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam , along with his second book, Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence. He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution. Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved. In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. # My Story...

**Peter -**
I wanted to give you a little backstory on who I am and how I have become the person I am today. [**I’ll get to that in a moment, but if you could, please consider donating to the campaign today. It would make a world of difference for what we are trying to do for Texas’s 8th district.**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=6544f40473&e=a2a46ff12c)
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/laurajonesforcongress?refcode=lnk](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=2ba1d94d4c&e=a2a46ff12c)
Born and raised in Houston, Texas, I am proud to call myself a native of this great state. As the oldest of three daughters, I grew up in the humble surroundings of a neighborhood in Southeast Houston. My parents, both hardworking individuals in blue-collar professions, instilled in me the values of diligence and perseverance.
After completing high school, I found employment at an assisted living community owned by Marriott. There, I developed a deep admiration and affection for the elderly, eventually becoming the kitchen manager. So, in my newfound passion for culinary arts, I enrolled in the renowned Culinary School at Houston Community College. Fate had a delightful surprise in store for me, as I met my husband during my time there. We tied the knot 25 years ago and have been blessed with six incredible children.
Cy-Fair, a suburb of Houston, with its thriving opportunities and exceptional public education system, provided a nurturing environment for our family. However, as it became increasingly crowded, my husband and I made the decision to relocate to a small rural county. Nestled amidst serene forests and vast acreage, we discovered a place that we now proudly call home. Our current homestead has a small farm, which is home to various livestock and bees, and a high-tunnel greenhouse.

However, being here has not been without challenges. The public education system in this area presented significant obstacles for our children. Nonetheless, we tirelessly sought alternatives, ensuring that our children flourished. Our youngest daughter gained admission to TAMS, an early college entrance residential program at the University of North Texas, at the age of 15. Our youngst son enlisted in the Army at the age of 17, where he now serves as a Sergeant in the esteemed 82nd Airborne unit.
Motivated by a desire to contribute to my new community, I volunteered at food banks and participated in various local organizations. As a member of the board of directors for both my local water company and a community center, I became intimately acquainted with the needs of the people I sought to represent.
During my period as County Chair and field director, my eyes were opened to the disparities faced by rural Texans—such as limited access to high-speed internet and healthcare facilities. Witnessing these inequalities ignited a fire within me, compelling me to advocate for the rights of every individual, ensuring their voices are heard and that they have access to essential resources like food and healthcare.
My journey has introduced me to remarkable individuals from across the political spectrum, each contributing to my personal growth and broadening my perspectives. I firmly believe that stepping out of one's comfort zone is instrumental in effecting positive change.
I am grateful for the life I lead, my wonderful neighbors, and the community I am honored to serve.

[**The people of District 8 and communities throughout it are deserving of compassionate, fair representation. I am ready to be a part of that representation. If you can stand by me in this and chip in today, I would appreciate it so muc** h.](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=274d6b5b44&e=a2a46ff12c)
| [Support This Campaign!](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=0b6d5d6a97&e=a2a46ff12c)
---
Thank you for reading my story and learning a little more about me and why this means so much.

\- Laura

Some in the Republican Party are suggesting that all U.S. support for Ukraine should be redirected toward Israel. This is wrong.
|
---
Friend,

When free, pro-American countries come under unprovoked, terroristic attacks—missiles fired at civilians, innocents abducted, tortured, and murdered—America stands by them to mourn, support, and help reestablish peace. That’s how we respond to terrorist attacks in Europe, to Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, and to Hamas’s horrifying attack in Israel. Some in the Republican Party are suggesting that all U.S. support for Ukraine should be redirected toward Israel. This is wrong. Israel and Ukraine need very different kinds of help, and the United States is powerful enough to help both. The House of Representatives is going to choose a new Speaker, and that individual will have enormous influence over whether or not America continues to support Ukraine. body:
There is a significant link between guns and domestic violence
#

We’d like to let you know that the email below discusses domestic violence. If this is not something you’d like to read about today, please click away.
If you or someone you love is in danger, please know that you are not alone. There are resources available to you. Call the National Domestic Violence Hotline at 1-800-799-7233 or text “START” to 88788 to be connected with an advocate.
* * *
[](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_scotus_pet_oct23/?source=em231011-1-30&refcode2=6692.3935704.lnZFbu&akid=6692%2E3935704%2ElnZFbu)
Friends -
October is Domestic Violence Awareness Month. As we continue our work towards a future free from gun violence, Domestic Violence Awareness Month serves as a solemn reminder of the connection between guns and domestic violence in our nation.
Firearms are used to commit over half of intimate partner homicides in the United States. Although anyone can be impacted by domestic violence, women are five times more likely to be killed by an abusive partner. Every year, more than 600 American women are shot and killed by intimate partners—roughly one every 14 hours.
Earlier this year, the Supreme Court announced that they will hear a case next term on whether or not people convicted of domestic abuse can buy and own guns.
Before this case is heard before the Supreme Court, we want to make sure all of our voices are heard.
[**In honor of Domestic Violence Awareness Month, will you sign on to say you believe domestic abusers should not have access to guns?**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_scotus_pet_oct23/?source=em231011-1-30&refcode2=6692.3935704.lnZFbu&akid=6692%2E3935704%2ElnZFbu)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_scotus_pet_oct23/?source=em231011-1-30&refcode2=6692.3935704.lnZFbu&akid=6692%2E3935704%2ElnZFbu)**
Thank you for speaking up.
\- The team at GIFFORDS

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com . We try to send only the most important information and opportunities to participate via email, but click [here](https://go.giffords.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1&akid=6692%2E3935704%2ElnZFbu) if you'd like to unsubscribe. Giffords PAC was started to support elected officials who step up to fight the gun violence epidemic. Thank you for standing with Gabby and the Giffords team.

| | _Janelle Bynum is running in one of the most competitive races in the country to flip Oregon's Fifth Congressional District from red to blue. You are receiving this email because of your past support for Democrats running to flip the House. If you prefer to unsubscribe from our emails,[click here](https://secure.ngpvan.com/p/_c7TYUhGv0qdnr7y-YXvqw2?unsubscribedata=cEKjP4FhMHJeP1g1XBHUkbYZM9ew6f6wBbCWYTMX4XuVmUQSnO%2FAxC33N9KHNMA4qQFy6Zsdj7Bum255p7xU533GwYA08e2cOkCLn56XWI11dHxifdNpImi8xVSmyyyam8XtaDWROdqLD9C9xA17kQtCBYrgGSPdzgCVN%2BgV6714vLIrcn99P4xYLbVDVgLLrg7J3nUo6%2FouaUza1%2B1JbmDpRN6Xx7zH47Uv%2B%2FwIQQHW4exwwpP%2BfXdB4VjnEeQLabCFP6ew3gbrTSR8b%2B6hBwWDMRzalVq1Fqwmqanyt6Ew44BJJ3HXEIRCWIFitlByiNwVbp07fATIm6sQS0batravZfQtQd%2By56XMrfbMUjmpPydhr%2FemmJQJduVWqOhsF3C1DAO%2F2sCkTwOca7Gau%2FLSzKmZ9ECWekDwkyNNTJ4iumS7AU%2B%2B4xvwDJDwQj%2BU)._

| | Friends,

**I have _never_ shied away from an opportunity to uplift our community and make it possible for all Oregonians to get ahead. **

As a legislator, a mother of four, and a small business owner, I know what we need now is courageous leadership to fight for our values – _no matter who tries to stand in the way._

I am proud to have earned a reputation as a tireless champion for real progress. In the state legislature, I’ve fought to safeguard reproductive freedom and our civil rights, create affordable housing, lower the cost of healthcare and prescription drugs, and create pathways to success for the next generation so everyone has a fair shot.

**I’m running for Congress in Oregon’s 5th District to bring that same fearless dedication to hard work and real results to D.C.**

I’m ready to get to work for working families on Day One, just as I’ve done in the Oregon Legislature, but I need to know what your top priorities are right now.

[Will you take a minute to fill out our survey and let me know which issues matter most to you in this election?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71381394/431925453/-792508367?source=JB_EM_WEL_NTL_230918_1_1&refcode2=975a9e37-3d68-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&contactdata=Oz10NksuDR9sUasI1kaiaVVHMaYqDXcoO11xqtQyzfphNbOslRysFldnChKv9kW+&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MjEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTc1YTllMzctM2Q2OC1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=RyHkbEme2yrqevf7ZfgwNYVgpXDUDuoDjwbhgJZ4Ym0=&emci=3acf6ff8-7556-ee11-9937-00224832e811&emdi=975a9e37-3d68-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=14434323)
| | [TAKE THE SURVEY](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71381396/431925455/-792508367?source=JB_EM_WEL_NTL_230918_1_1&refcode2=975a9e37-3d68-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&contactdata=Oz10NksuDR9sUasI1kaiaVVHMaYqDXcoO11xqtQyzfphNbOslRysFldnChKv9kW+&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MjEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTc1YTllMzctM2Q2OC1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=RyHkbEme2yrqevf7ZfgwNYVgpXDUDuoDjwbhgJZ4Ym0=&emci=3acf6ff8-7556-ee11-9937-00224832e811&emdi=975a9e37-3d68-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=14434323)
---

As the daughter of educators and the granddaughter of a police officer, I learned the importance of working hard and serving your community from an early age. That spirit of selflessness has been my north star, guiding every decision I’ve made – including the decision to run for Congress.

Here in Happy Valley, where my husband and I chose to make a home and raise our children, too many families are struggling. The skyrocketing costs of education, healthcare, and housing are making it impossible for anyone to get ahead, and our elected officials in D.C. are too distracted with partisan bickering to deal with the problem.

Friend,

It's nearly time to nominate and vote for a new Speaker of the House of Representatives, and I want you to know where I stand. **My good friend and colleague, Jim Jordan (OH-04), has announced his bid for Speaker, and I am standing firmly behind him.**

I'll be blunt; Jim Jordan is best equipped to unite the conference, grow the Party, and get to the REAL issue at hand - serving the American people and moving our agenda forward. | Friend,
Our first fundraising quarter has come to a close and I am excited to announce that we raised over $102,000 in just 19 days! That's right, just 19 days. To say that I'm both thankful and blown away at the same time would both be understatements. Because of your support, we are building a winning campaign that will inspire voters for real change in this district. However, our fundraising success is not the only piece of good news that I have to share today. I am also pleased to announce the endorsement of our campaign by the DuPage Township GOP! We are so excited to also have the endorsement of Chairman Antonio Timothee, and all the great patriots from the DuPage Township GOP.

**Carbon County Sheriff Dan Zeigler Endorsement**
I am proud to be endorsed by Carbon County Sheriff Dan Zeigler. I will always stand with the brave men and women of law enforcement and continue to work for the safety of our communities. In announcing his support, Sheriff Zeigler said simply, “Ryan has what takes to keep our community safe.”

* * *
**Susan Wild uses Official X Account to Share Political Propaganda, Possibly Triggering Ethics Violation**
My campaign released a press release yesterday in response to Congresswoman Susan Wild sharing political propaganda on her official, taxpayer-run X account. Thanks to our efforts in pointing out her egregious ethical stumble, Wild had to take her out-of-bounds post down. Here’s the release:

**Susan Wild uses Official X Account to Share Political Propaganda, Possibly Triggering Ethics Violation

(LOWER MACUNGIE, Pa.) -** Yesterday morning, Susan Wild, ranking member and former chair of the House Ethics Committee, reposted content from "the official digital rapid response channel of the Biden-Harris campaign" to her official US House X account. Her post indicated that she believes the recent attacks on Israel have nothing to do with funds released to Iran by the Biden Administration.

In response to Susan Wild's inaccurate statement and blatant use of political propaganda on her Official US House page, Ryan Mackenzie, the leading Republican Candidate for Pennsylvania's 7th Congressional district, issued two responses on X, the first of which focused on the policy being discussed. You can view that post [here.](http://links.mackenzieforcongress.com/u/click?_t=e09c1376a1134fb5bbc6c87f9d1914fb&_m=08b675cfc2a744d8a5e47505ef5f340e&_e=bAHFYbs0ASwNyencz35dXZCWpOmit8d_X0_aodnlVyTMcSTmy6t8xnGpPAxPnbfr1mUImsW4kCer3B7Jlb5zm0iqSDozESxENsAWnP_tgu-JciAUqxJp7OWFOkZzedPLwPs181GxTDHEscf0v3Td31qUHdfkD_UpP9_T1Rqm0zidXxWc4UiuIzGF0K0iwykiojn7tlXLcEggAnFv7uCBL1AoQyteaTt_qNZygfByZloJH_S4kClWc8O0CSd9IkSh)

_"Everyone knows money is fungible. Please don't ask people to believe your political propaganda about the $6 billion Biden released for use by Iran. Below are articles from[NBC](http://links.mackenzieforcongress.com/u/click?_t=e09c1376a1134fb5bbc6c87f9d1914fb&_m=08b675cfc2a744d8a5e47505ef5f340e&_e=bAHFYbs0ASwNyencz35dXa_Z3p8ivL0gv9TfUXMbxigVbmBPG-f0Uzvs64xeDd0FxcM_x5jzBMA3gbRTfZ0-W8-DqjQ30zbjQc_ciNMz75sG7bd6hs7dIGnMN_4C9sDAtYWj8tH_7JnSmEVj8yza_O_HKXo2JEsUncdkw11Lu554t9Ssb-bdj-jaQCIfmZSWHG762NNAbrtB0cbLzxWOjvmz7EZRbubvGZEvphVf31JmvJZK58f2MGNp8qEn5-lWJif0so6OfeaPnGveZBiKB1mPpr3XgLz3aXLuTp2y06ugxda3bafUmB4qT_oqoZso) (Iran saying they will spend the money however they want on Sept 12th) and [CNN](http://links.mackenzieforcongress.com/u/click?_t=e09c1376a1134fb5bbc6c87f9d1914fb&_m=08b675cfc2a744d8a5e47505ef5f340e&_e=bAHFYbs0ASwNyencz35dXVqwuom-nYiFmIST6h0fax3HDveTHaJ4vsT6z1Dhh7xPUxu2LImun7zSlykF7ddVbqCR1BNrHCIFT8zyr-bnMQ1hmqrrcb-ekNUusEGlf0oXe057b1TjAVIY2Ka-dIcsNjnZcoXJonaXmzYrX-gprkFCD4Lx7DN60obJtm7kY69GPnRBKUAcHvsu2JL8aWop1kyf626LHq5l8yhwEpLeBlAKkg0iIZDe71AoCShYkCyHCqdpXsE-uk0jmrPbYnS2qA%3D%3D) (saying Iran had access to the money in a Qatari bank on Sept 18th."_

Wild's posting of Biden-Harris campaign material on her official US House X account appears to violate the prohibition on campaign activity, as laid out in the [House Ethics Manual](http://links.mackenzieforcongress.com/u/click?_t=e09c1376a1134fb5bbc6c87f9d1914fb&_m=08b675cfc2a744d8a5e47505ef5f340e&_e=bAHFYbs0ASwNyencz35dXU4MMHA3CuFNfoMyIg4uQDKEO5RtH9hG9USKhoeinyibJdU4nVOmOljAY3SICoj2zdY3-NdPIKGIueU9K1h7CgLnGiLzHRb8rnKc0EN8K08JMT4rbd4Z2mjjlSNbWGLaodfv9QnKlkV77fJzsg9i22zhLv67LF5qzm1JvboAEruFP-eoEkHRQl11SGFKMuN6PGaeGvymivLj8T3gQi41VFcMKW7gTUEXUI-bwDGCUuhNNA_U7KKD6KfGYVN6V-iHCy1o7VL4PBYuxyHDQS_H7vCoW7zzy7rpdkQdGk5wzdDy), a document she should be very familiar with as the ranking member and former chair of the Committee.

Mackenzie's second post on X responded to Wild's inappropriate use of her official X account:

_"Can someone explain why Susan Wild is using official US House X account to post political propaganda from the Joe Biden campaign?"_

Check out his post [here.](http://links.mackenzieforcongress.com/u/click?_t=e09c1376a1134fb5bbc6c87f9d1914fb&_m=08b675cfc2a744d8a5e47505ef5f340e&_e=bAHFYbs0ASwNyencz35dXZCWpOmit8d_X0_aodnlVyTMcSTmy6t8xnGpPAxPnbfrtz7XRD__-aue84EAk3DRRhfmc8EBm8mn2jDTrG2Th58Y3IJH8ibMkXKPSpOkGVaAuzw6Nh4_GuTSp2xHyMEc5asg4iC3Dr_3FqwTNuprZ-wBJkMCh75FvPIOuB4wZ9WsfcFK40UOkKnLLWtU7kCwWxToYfkL6eLdfHehRV0aIUbssTRj5-Vs3oGpXP1km68V)

Following posts by Mackenzie addressing Wild's possible ethics violation, Wild deleted the post, thereby acknowledging the misuse of her official government account.

Eric

democracy

Derek, it’s
Adam.

My mid-month fundraising deadline is just a few short days away, and we
are getting close to hitting our fundraising goal. If everyone reading
this email pitched in $10, we would hit our goal.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1312?c0=oct2023_abs_em.JYMaWc&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_MMG_AC90_20231011_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=4221%2E5257348%2EmUxyE6 ]Will you take the next step and help us reach the finish
line, Derek?
Make a donation now:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1312?c0=oct2023_abs_em.JYMaWc&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_MMG_AC90_20231011_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1006&akid=4221%2E5257348%2EmUxyE6 ]DONATE $10

We are writing a new chapter in our nation’s history. Navigating times
like these requires leaders who are ready to take on our toughest
challenges. That’s exactly what I have spent my career doing.

When an aluminum company paid smugglers to haul toxic waste and illegally
dump it across the border, I took them to court — and won. That
prosecution was the first of its time, and it set a powerful precedent
that no company — big or small — could avoid accountability when harming
our people and our planet.

When a Republican member of Congress refused to take action in the best
interest of our community, I said enough was enough. I stepped up and ran
for office against him. In what was the most expensive House race ever at
that time, I defeated the incumbent, flipped the seat blue, and became
only the second Democrat to represent the seat in a century.

When Californians demanded action, I answered. I’ve brought people
together to expand health care access for millions of Americans, to lower
the cost of prescription drugs, to invest millions of dollars back into
our infrastructure, and to expand affordable housing.

And when Donald Trump tried to undermine our democracy, I stood up to
defend it. I served as the lead Manager for Trump’s first impeachment
trial in the Senate — and together, we secured the first bipartisan vote
ever to convict a sitting president.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2023_abs_em.EYisyV&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_MMG_AC90_20231011_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1008&akid=4221%2E5257348%2EmUxyE6 ]Headline that reads: Adam Schiff lays out a damning case in impeachment
trial opening remarks. >From Jan 23, 2020

I’m not afraid of rolling up my sleeves and getting to work. I’m ready to
continue working to deliver results so every Californian — no matter who
they are, where they live, and who they love — can live out their dream.

But I can’t do it alone.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1312?c0=oct2023_abs_em.JYMaWc&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_MMG_AC90_20231011_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1009&akid=4221%2E5257348%2EmUxyE6 ]Derek, I

body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71393583/431969824/-531765509?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NTE3NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMDIwN2Q0Ni00ZjY4LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HmDIiw7r0fkcgEAoHismA92yQvQrY42ZIorDk_UB7LM=&emci=b6c4fa6f-a663-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=30207d46-4f68-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=10203249) Hey team,

Today is National Coming Out Day! On days like this, I’m always reminded of The Holiday, Pittsburgh's oldest gay bar.

You see, when I was growing up my parents owned a bar right across the street from The Holiday. At a time when the gay community was under constant threat and forced to hide, the owners, Chuck and Chuck, were my parents' friends and neighbors in the most ordinary way.

Seeing LGBTQ+ people living openly and authentically when I would run across the street to borrow some ice taught me important lessons about love and acceptance — and also reminded me how they had so few places where they were able to be themselves.

When I look back on the strides the LGBTQ+ community has made in demanding — and winning — equal rights and acceptance, I think back to the people at the Holiday who simply wanted to be true to themselves and the people they loved. I think about how hard it is for so many people to tell others about how they feel and who they truly are.

Throughout my career in public office, I’ve been proud to use my platform to speak up for and defend the rights of LGBTQ+ Pennsylvanians, because no one should be discriminated against because of who they are or who they love. **As your Attorney General, I will fight for equality and to advance and expand LGBTQ+ rights — on this day, and every day — until all Pennsylvanians are treated equally in the eyes of the law.**

In solidarity,

Eugene DePasquale

I will never stop standing up for what I know is right-even when
