Friend,

The
time for chirping from the sidelines is over.

Talk is ineffective, and that's why my message has been simple:
2024 is the time to put up or shut up.

As
a leader, your job is to put the interests of the people you
serve above your own political gain. I've done that in Florida,
and I've watched the American people cry out for real leadership
nationwide. I am looking forward to rising to the occasion to
show the nation that leadership.

I
debate and defend what I KNOW is right-even when it goes against
the grain of the approved elite media narrative.

The
American people deserve a President with a track record of taking
action and standing for what's right. The lack of action from our
leaders across this country has gone on for far too long. Joe
Biden has done more to damage to our nation than anyone, and
Kamala Harris has done nothing at all.

I
am DONE listening to excuses, and I know you are too. If
Republicans want to ditch the culture of losing, then it's time
we try something new. In Florida, I showed the country the
playbook for defeating the woke mob:

Giving parents back their voice in the classroom by BANNING CRT
and pornographic content for young kids

STANDING UP against corporations who have tried to force
taxpayers to fund an ESG agenda

DEFEATING Faucism and giving back Floridians the freedom to
breathe and see their families after the elites in DC shut down
the country

I
promise you, with me as your nominee for President, Republicans
will forget this culture of losing once and for all. This is a
race to defeat Joe Biden. That is my focus. To get that done, I
am asking for your continued support. If you can, will you pitch
in $25 today?

The
time to act is now. The time for leadership is now.

2024 is going to be the year that our Great American Comeback
takes shape. Decline is a choice. Success is attainable. And
freedom is worth fighting for. We will fight back and WIN.

I
am humbly asking for your support today, Friend. Join me, and we
will put an end to the culture of losing that has surrounded the
Republican party. We will keep the woke indoctrination away from
kids, the way we live our lives, the curriculum taught in
schools, and the consumer choices we make.

Stand with me on the debate stage: Donate

Our
Great American Comeback is attainable as long as we're willing to
fight for it.

In
Freedom,

Ron
DeSantis

Meet Ron DeSantis

A native Floridian with
blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a
nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin
High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he
was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated
with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission
in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service,
Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah,
Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military
decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service
and the Iraq Campaign Medal.

Ron
also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child
predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a
platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits
and a balanced budget amendment.

In
Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the
weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to
hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in
manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a
veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our
country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans
and expand support for mental health.

In
2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As
governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for
the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when
the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media
united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis
stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding
principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to
transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival.
Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative
priorities:

Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine
mandates,

Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border
crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against
illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured
professors accountable,

Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital
currency,

Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

Protecting the unborn,

Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a
constitutional carry state,

Expanding education freedom,

Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and
entities,

Lowering prescription drug costs,

Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

Creating a universal school choice program,

Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme
Court,

...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout
his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of
nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the
largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than
1.5 million votes.

But
history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the
majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional
wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently
as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30
points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red,
including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties
overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor
DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics,
and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with
battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing
down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his
inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense
suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of
sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even
for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we
choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than
cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe
place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership,
Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education
opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden
Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that
seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to
the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered
the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's
history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:

Record tax relief

ESG prohibitions

Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering
transparency

Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

Improvements to our state's infrastructure

Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death
penalty for child rapists

The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border
crisis

Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward
school unions

Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No
leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor
DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country,
leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron
is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television
anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters,
Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

Joe Biden has done more to damage to our nation than anyone, and Kamala Harris has done nothing at all. I am DONE listening to excuses, and I know you are too. If Republicans want to ditch the culture of losing, then it's time we try something new. In Florida, I showed the country the playbook for defeating the woke mob: Giving parents back their voice in the classroom by BANNING CRT and pornographic content for young kids STANDING UP against corporations who have tried to force taxpayers to fund an ESG agenda DEFEATING Faucism and giving back Floridians the freedom to breathe and see their families after the elites in DC shut down the country I promise you, with me as your nominee for President, Republicans will forget this culture of losing once and for all. This is a race to defeat Joe Biden. That is my focus. To get that done, I am asking for your continued support. If you can, will you pitch in $25 today? PITCH IN $25 PITCH IN $47 PITCH IN $75 PITCH IN $100 PITCH IN $150 PITCH IN $200 The time to act is now. The time for leadership is now. 2024 is going to be the year that our Great American Comeback takes shape. Decline is a choice. Success is attainable. And freedom is worth fighting for. We will fight back and WIN. I am humbly asking for your support today, Friend. Join me, and we will put an end to the culture of losing that has surrounded the Republican party. We will keep the woke indoctrination away from kids, the way we live our lives, the curriculum taught in schools, and the consumer choices we make. Stand with me on the debate stage: Donate HERE Our Great American Comeback is attainable as long as we're willing to fight for it. In Freedom, Ron DeSantis Meet Ron DeSantis A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer. During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal. Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment. In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health. In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular. Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities: Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates, Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities, Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT, Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable, Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency, Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation, Turning Florida into a model for election integrity, Protecting the unborn, Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state, Expanding education freedom, Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities, Lowering prescription drug costs, Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable, Creating a universal school choice program, Delivering record-breaking tax relief, Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership, Supporting law enforcement and our veterans, Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders, Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court, ...and so much more. After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes. But history didn't stop there: Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points. Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall. Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women. Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism." Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history. This year, Governor DeSantis signed: Record tax relief ESG prohibitions Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation. Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI Improvements to our state's infrastructure Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. name: LTC(R) Christian Castelli
subject: America is paralyzed
body:
Dear Peter,

It's been a week since Kevin McCarthy was removed and the United States Congress still doesn't have Speaker of the House to perform its necessary duties.

Israel was attacked in a cowardice terrorist plot involving Iran and carried out by Hamas, and Congress has yet to act.

Our southern border is unsecured leaving America's homeland vulnerable to terrorists and enemies.

_I 'm Christian Castelli. My military service includes 22 years as a soldier and Green Beret, decorated combat veteran and senior advisor at The Pentagon._

[__](https://secure.winred.com/committee-to-elect-christian-castelli/donate-today)

Not being prepared, not having a plan, and not ready to solve the challenges in front of me is not in my nature.

America is paralyzed right now. Where are all the adults?

As a soldier, Green Beret, decorated combat veteran, and former senior Advisor at The Pentagon, it was our duty to be prepared and have answers.

I am running for Congress because we need adults in the room. We need experienced, tested, and proven conservative leadership to meet our challenges.

* Stand united with Israel against terrorism, and provide them the resources to destroy it.
* Secure and close our border so terrorist cannot attack our schools, churches, synagogues, government institutions, and gathering places.
* Return to the business of the American people to strengthen our economy by eliminating Bidenomics, inflation, and dependence on foreign energy.

If you want experienced, tested, and proven conservative leaders and adults in Congress. If you want America's priorities addressed. Join me and make a donation of $25, $50, $100, $250, $500 or whatever you can today.

| | Fellow American,
---
For this week's Hold the Line Podcast, I join my good friend Eric Metaxas on his show. We hit on some critical topics for our age, where we are in America, and how the spiritual war we are facing goes beyond politics and requires the full armor of God to fight.

We discuss the openly evil satanic bondage strip show at Knotts Berry Farm’s, and how woke corporations despise Christians, our values, and the God we worship. Eric shares that many have become complicit with evil and want to “make peace” with it — but for Christians, that is not an option.

I hope this episode serves as a wake up call for those Christians who are unaware of the stakes we face, and a call to arms to those of us who are in the fight!

Peter, House Republicans are in complete chaos.

After months of Republican infighting and threats from Trump loyalists, former House Speaker Kevin McCarthy became the first speaker to be ousted _in American history_.

Americans have been paying the price for a dysfunctional House majority since early January. Republicans spent _weeks_ in disarray before eventually electing former Speaker McCarthy, and their scramble to find a new speaker means yet _another_ government shutdown is on the horizon.

This chaos is exactly what we can expect from today's Republican party, Peter: These are politicians who **simply cannot govern**. Americans need representatives in Congress who will fight for our fundamental rights and protect our democracy — _not destroy them_.
**We're asking pro-choice activists across the country to weigh in. Do you approve of the House under Republican leadership?**

body:
Her go-to drink is diet Dr. Pepper.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=31276%2E3422442%2EW6ygv5)
Derek, you might know Katie as the “woman with the whiteboard,” or as a Congresswoman from Orange County. **But here are a few more fun things you may not know:**
1. As a kid, Katie was an active member of 4-H.

2. In college, Katie was an intern for Senator Chuck Grassley. While their politics differ, she respected that his office took the time to reply to everyone who wrote in. She’s brought that same goal of listening to constituents to her own Congressional office.

3. Katie studied consumer protection under Elizabeth Warren in law school.

4. Katie’s daughter Betsy is named after Elizabeth Warren.

5. Her go-to drink is diet Dr. Pepper.

6. Katie’s grocery store of choice is Albertsons (the workers there are unionized!).

7. A single mom of three, Katie served as her kids’ Cub Scout leader.

8. Her mom is a quilter, and you can see some of her work in the background of Katie’s Zooms or TV interviews.

9. She’s a huge fan of fiction and reads several books a week (thanks to a long plane commute between California and D.C.).

10. After graduating from college, Katie taught English to 8th graders in Hong Kong.

Here’s the deal, Katie isn't a career politician. She’s a working parent who ran for office after Trump was elected and flipped a red seat blue. **In the Senate, she’ll fight everyday to protect workers and families and hold power to account.** [**Can you pitch in and help send her to the United States Senate?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231011-1?refcode=EMAM11_1_FUN_20231011_V1_F&refcode2=31276_3422442_W6ygv5&akid=31276%2E3422442%2EW6ygv5)

–Team Porter

Loomer: Now, according to financial reports, on February 7th, 2023, Yass, who is one of the largest investors into TikTok, donated $2.5 million to Ron DeSantis' state committee PAC in an effort to support Governor Ron DeSantis after he had already secured a second term as governor of Florida. Loomer: Yass has also expressed interest in supporting Ron DeSantis' presidential campaign. Loomer: And not only that, but according to FEC reports and this year alone, Jeff Yass has contributed over $15 million to the Club for Growth. Loomer: Why does this matter? Well, the Club for Growth is notoriously anti-Trump. In 2016, when Ron DeSantis was a congressman and Club for Growth was praising him as a member of Congress and giving him a glowing review, especially given the fact that as a member of Congress, Ron DeSantis both signed off on and voted in favor of the TPP which Donald Trump has publicly condemned and even went so far as to remove when he was president of the United States. Loomer: The Club for Growth has publicly said that they will not be supporting Donald Trump for reelection in 2024 and will instead be focused on other candidates who they say actually have a chance of winning the general election. Loomer: Now, it's no secret that Club for Growth has aggressively opposed Donald Trump's tough on China trade policies. And Club for Growth itself is notorious for being a free trade organization that opposes all tariffs on Chinese trade. Loomer: Given those facts, it's no wonder why the Club for Growth is lining up to support Ron DeSantis and his presidential campaign Loomer: And let's not forget that when Donald Trump was in the White House during his first term, he publicly stated that he wanted to ban TikTok. Loomer: And of course, in response to those statements, Donald Trump received a lot of public backlash. So given the fact that we are now once again in a presidential election year, it's no surprise as to why some of these biggest venture capitalists, investors and hedge fund managers who own very large stakes in Bytedance, the parent company of TikTok, are lining up to give millions of dollars to candidates like Ron DeSantis, who are anti-Trump. Loomer: By donating millions of dollars to Ron DeSantis and his super PAC, Never Back Down, donors and billionaires like Ken Griffin, Doug Leone and Jeff Yass are ensuring that there will be a constant revolving door of access for all of them and their businesses associates, as well as the Chinese Communist Party, to have access to the White House, very much like we see is the current situation with Joe Biden and Hunter Biden, who have completely sold our country out to the Chinese Communist Party. Loomer: So while Ron DeSantis can publicly tell people that he wants to ban TikTok as a way to protect children and to stop data mining, and that he's going to make sure that a key part of his economic policy is being tough on China, as he recently told The Wall Street Journal this last week, his actions and his fundraising reports suggest the exact opposite. Loomer: Now, you may have heard some people say, oh, we have to vote for Ron DeSantis because Ron DeSantis is basically Trump without the baggage. But as I have clearly shown you in this video, that couldn't be further from the truth, because Ron DeSantis and Donald Trump clearly have opposite views when it comes to how to deal with China and our economic trade policy with foreign nations. Loomer: While Donald Trump is not an advocate of free trade, Ron DeSantis and his associates at Club for Growth or Club for China growth, as President Trump likes to call them, are clearly in favor of America last trade policies that export our jobs overseas at the expense of American factory workers and American manufacturers who are losing their jobs to cheap labor overseas in countries like China. Loomer: While speaking at a conference in China, Wall Street billionaire and Citadel CEO Ken Griffin publicly said that he is looking to support Ron DeSantis' presidential campaign. And during the same conference, he actually praised China's communist leader, Xi Jinping, for his commitment to, "accelerating China's economic growth." Loomer: Now I think that it should set off a lot of red flags and alarms that Ron DeSantis' top donor, Ken Griffin, who according to financial reports, gave him $5 million for his reelection campaign, is saying publicly that investment in China is a center of focus for his company, Citadel. Loomer: Do we really want to elect somebody as president of the United States who is bankrolled by billionaires who are completely compromised by the Chinese Communist Party? Loomer: I don't think so. We've already seen on both sides of the political aisle, whether it's Ron DeSantis or Joe and Hunter Biden, how dangerous it can be when our politicians allow themselves to become slaves of corporate interests and foreign nations. Loomer: Getting our country back on track and restoring an America first strong economy means decoupling ourselves from China. Loomer: This is something that Ron DeSantis' hedge fund billionaire donors, people like Jeff Yass, Ken Griffin, and Doug Leone, completely opposed. And that's exactly why they are supporting Ron DeSantis as opposed to Donald Trump. Loomer: Along with donating $5 million to Ron DeSantis' reelection campaign, Ken Griffin of Citadel received a $1 billion investment from Sequoia Capital in 2022. Loomer: This is a considerable financial backing that helped facilitate Ken Griffin's reentry into China after an enforced exit by the Chinese Communist Party five years prior. President Trump: Ken Griffin, Citadel. What a guy he is. Where are you Ken? Where the hell is Ken? Loomer: And what does this mean with regards to the 2024 presidential election? Well, it means that financial powerhouses Citadel and Sequoia, along with the Chinese Communist Party, clearly have a vested interest in seeing Ron DeSantis in the White House. Loomer: Lax trade policies with China, including a reduction or complete elimination of tariffs, means that all of these hedge fund billionaires who also happen to be GOP mega-donors will make billions of dollars on their investments and their business dealings with the Chinese Communist Party. Loomer: And what does this mean? Well, for people like Ken Griffin and Doug Leone and Jeff Yass, it means that they're going to get richer. And for Ron DeSantis, it means that his campaign coffers are going to be flooded with millions of dollars of more donations. Loomer: But for the average American, they're going to be left paying the ultimate price as American manufacturing and products and labor is shipped overseas to China. Loomer: It's pretty obvious that Ron DeSantis will say and do anything if it means getting a large financial contribution from a Wall Street or hedge fund billionaire. DeSantis: My policy was, you know, if you want to give money to me, I'll take any lawful donations. Loomer: We've seen the financial reports and there's no reconciling the fact that he can't have his cake and eat it, too. Ron DeSantis can't be telling voters on the campaign trail that he's going to have an economic and trade policy that's tough on China and that he's going to ban TikTok for the sake of improving our national security and protecting children from predators online and then behind closed doors at his swanky fundraisers, be taking millions of dollars in donations from some of the largest investors into Bytedance, which is, of course, the parent company of TikTok. Loomer: There's a reason why Ron DeSantis' presidential campaign is being called an absolute Desaster. In fact, it's been described by many political consultants as one of the worst political rollouts in U.S. history. Loomer: And as Ron DeSantis continues to lie through his teeth on the campaign trail and flip flop on policy positions, as I just showed you, he will continue to plummet in the polls. Loomer: The choice is pretty clear for voters this election season. If they wish to continue to have an economic reliance on Chinese manufacturing overseas, as opposed to bringing back manufacturing here to the United States, then perhaps they should vote for Ron DeSantis. But if they wish to improve national security and have a president that's going to put America first as opposed to their rich Wall Street and hedge fund billionaire donors, as Ron DeSantis is doing, then you probably want to vote for Donald Trump, who has a tried and true proven history of being tough on China and always putting the American worker, the American manufacturer and the American family first. The 2024 presidential election is shaping up to be an all-out slugfest. Establishment forces are working overtime in their efforts to stack the deck against President Donald Trump. Recently, I exclusively reported and [uncovered a major conflict of interest that exists in the current leadership of the Florida Republican Party](https://substack.com/redirect/2c90bca5-61f2-4421-9d41-b53968c30a8e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), including Republican Party of Florida (RPOF) Chair Christian Ziegler, and Vice Chair Evan Power, which undermines their requirement to be neutral in the Florida Republican Presidential primary.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/4d7cd793-e495-47e5-bdf3-b1304ee4b5ba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
In the case of Ziegler, his wife Bridget is actively campaigning for DeSantis's Presidential campaign, while Power's wife Melissa is the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of DeSantis' campaign!
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/37e8e7a0-ed5c-4f11-938c-ab52073de136?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

---|---|---
On top of being the current DeSantis campaign CFO, Mrs. Power was [reportedly](https://substack.com/redirect/32bd0076-2e55-4805-896a-6b209ae90237?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in charge of the Governor's finances during his 2022 campaign.
Chairman Ziegler's wife, on top of her public support for DeSantis' campaign, is [currently employed](https://substack.com/redirect/8a2da23a-d927-401c-b15b-bd8b39840a93?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by the Leadership Institute, a group that despite its stated mission of "Providing training for youth in campaigns, grassroots organizing, and communication," has begun shifting resources to launch what is [widely considered](https://substack.com/redirect/32bd0076-2e55-4805-896a-6b209ae90237?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a grassroots operation in support of DeSantis.
Chairman Ziegler himself has also made public statements boosting DeSantis' prospects for the White House:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1f032294-7326-45de-b054-48ff171b62eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Since I exposed this clear conflict of interest, [Powers responded](https://substack.com/redirect/32bd0076-2e55-4805-896a-6b209ae90237?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to _Floridian Press_ reporter Javier Manjarres with a bad-faith deflection.
> _" It's not against the rules. It's a circular bullshit argument," said Power. "The party has nothing to do with the primary."_
While it is technically true that the RPOF doesn't run the primary elections, they do have [a lot of power](https://substack.com/redirect/9a8ca623-224a-49b8-a2c5-7068648796b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) when it comes to seating delegates at the Republican National Convention (RNC), where the Republican nominee for President is ultimately selected.

While the delegates selected in Florida are supposed to be bound to the candidate who won the primary election, it is not uncommon for rogue delegates to attempt to skirt that duty and instead support the candidate of their choice.
During the 2016 RNC in Cleveland, Ohio, the Never Trump faction of the Party went so far as to attempt to change convention rules to permit rogue delegates to ignore the will of the voters and deny Trump the nomination.
The leader of that Never Trump last-stand was [Ken Cuccinelli](https://substack.com/redirect/ab202e4d-1812-4bab-bc8c-992a1d4ccb2b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), who[ founded](https://substack.com/redirect/b8c612cb-40eb-4d97-a551-35dd918460fc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the pro-DeSantis Super PAC Never Back Down.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ab202e4d-1812-4bab-bc8c-992a1d4ccb2b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

Top DeSantis figures, like Ken Cuccinelli, have already proven they aren't above stealing the nomination on the convention floor. Corrupt Party officials biased against President Trump would be instrumental in pulling off such a heist.

Friend, Today is the first day of early voting in Indiana’s municipal elections. No excuse is required to vote early, so we urge you to vote ASAP!
**By casting your ballot early, you can avoid the lines on Election Day and help Hoosier Republicans build early leads.**

**[Follow this secure link to find information on voting hours and polling locations>>](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/eb951f7690955bbe3947229f28c3afba/696f1d758e62050ec3d6b838967d376c/40313)**

We’re counting on your help to elect principled conservatives who will keep taxes low, support local law enforcement, and ensure our all of our municipalities deliver on the best quality of life possible. This election is crucial so be sure to bring your family and friends to vote too. We have a lot of crucial races this year. We need your help from Evansville to Indianapolis to Fort Wayne, and everywhere in between. Hey Peter – Raquel here.
As a legislator, I traveled to El Salvador, where there is a total abortion ban. Our delegation met women who were incarcerated for having obstetric emergencies or miscarriages.
We’ve seen across our country the systemic attack on reproductive freedoms since the overturning of Roe last summer, including here at home in Arizona.
We’ve also seen individuals across this country fight back against these attacks. Here in Arizona, major abortion rights groups are working to launch a bid that would enshrine abortion protections into the Arizona Constitution in 2024.

This is not a hyperbole, and this is our reality. That’s why I fully support ensuring that Arizonans have access to legal and safe abortion. Join me in support of this by adding your name to our petition >> [https://secure.ngpvan.com/G_BWR4XDrECczL7495m9vw2]

Our hearts are with her and her family. At the same time, with critical deadlines approaching, Team Mary is turning to our community of supporters to finish October strong on behalf of all Alaskans.*
Peter, I’m asking you to split a donation between my campaign and Mary Peltola’s today. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/2310-q4-peltola-split-gampem?refcode=231011-email]
Let me explain why.
I know you’re frustrated. I know you’re scared. I know you’re, quite frankly, fed the hell up.
A contingent of extremist Republicans in Congress can’t get their act together to pass a proper budget bill. If they can’t govern well enough to fund the government, we can’t confidently say we’ll make good on our debt payments. We can’t do much of anything until we have a new Speaker.
This is a time for leadership, not partisanship. It’s a time for solutions, not finger-pointing to try and score a cheap political point. I’m working every day in Washington with folks like Rep. Peltola to bring results, bring stability, and bring security.
But I’ll be honest: we’ve got the odds stacked against us right now. Too many far-right extremist politicians are interested in their moment in the spotlight or pandering to an extremist base. They can’t do what needs to be done in this moment.
Me and Mary are Americans first. And we will always do what is right to protect our country, protect our allies, and allow our people to thrive.
We need more folks who will work with us in Congress to get things done. Will you help us protect our seats and bring us one step closer to creating a government that fights for everyday Americans by splitting a donation between our campaigns today? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/2310-q4-peltola-split-gampem?refcode=231011-email]
Thank you for anything you’re able to give.
- Wiley

**Yesterday was one of the darkest days in Israel 's history as the Iranian-backed terrorist group, Hamas, killed hundreds of Israelis, injured thousands more, and abducted several dozen civilians and soldiers.

We cannot, and will not, remain silent while our brothers and sisters in the Holy Land are facing their most perilous moment. As Americans, we lived through the horrors of 9/11 and during that trying time, our Israeli friends stood shoulder to shoulder in our war against terror. This is Israel's 9/11, and they need our unwavering and steadfast support.**

Fellow American,

**We are Americans.**

At the end of the day, that is our most unifying principle. That spirit of unity is a centerpiece of my campaign. We cannot establish a national identity without saying, "I am proud to be American."

A President can and should be the best example of that ideal. Someone who listens to every American, even if they disagree on issues or on how to make America stronger. That's exactly why I need to hear from you now, Fellow American.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

**The Hamas-led attacks on Israel were barbaric and cannot be condoned.** We require a rational response that supports Israel while avoiding another U.S.-led disaster in the Middle East.

I am disappointed and deeply concerned by the remarks of certain presidential candidates including Nikki Haley who have irresponsibly called the Hamas attack an 'attack on America' and rabidly shout 'FINISH THEM!!' repeatedly without offering a pragmatic path forward.

The U.S. should provide Israel with diplomatic support, intelligence-sharing, and necessary munitions to defend its own homeland, while taking special care to avoid a broader regional war in the Middle East that would *not* advance U.S. interests:
1. Offer Israel robust intelligence support and stand ready to provide additional military supplies via both sale and transfer.
2. Immediately confirm an American ambassador to Israel, with the vacant embassies in Egypt, Libya, and Oman to be filled in quick succession.
3. End all further nuclear proliferation in the Middle East, including the full phase-out of Iran's nuclear program and immediately ending Biden's disastrous plan to share nuclear technology with Saudi Arabia.
4. Fast-track the deportation of any resident aliens who have served with Hamas or Palestinian Islamic Jihad, including extradition to Israeli custody where appropriate.
5. Work with Israel to identify countries willing to accept peaceful Palestinians who wish to escape the pressures of Hamas and facilitate their emigration.
6. Warn the UN of consequences if its historical pattern of drawing false equivalences between Israel and the terrorists who target it continues.

Many Republicans are reacting to the barbaric Hamas attack on Israel with hysteria rather than rationality. History teaches us this isn't the formula for success.

Dealing with this needs to be a top U.S. priority.

Warn the UN of consequences if its historical pattern of drawing false equivalences between Israel and the terrorists who target it continues. Many Republicans are reacting to the barbaric Hamas attack on Israel with hysteria rather than rationality. History teaches us this isn't the formula for success. What happened to the “personal responsibility” they love to tout?

Thankfully, the American people aren’t buying it. The GOP created this chaos entirely within their own party. Now, they’re trying to use the sideshow to take out one of the Democrats most committed to getting things done?

They raised nine kids on two paychecks. | Today that would be impossible. The cost of living has never been higher. American families have never suffered as much as they are right now. I have two kids of my own now, and I refuse to leave them in a country where THE American Dream is out of reach. I've tried my best to be a Mama Bear: I've worked hard and raised my family, all while remaining ignorant of the grand illusion that this country has been building around us. In reality -- we've lost control of the destiny of this nation. At some point, the American voters got sidelined in favor of Washington's agenda, which doesn't include the best interest of everyday Americans like you and me. THIS COUNTRY IS ABOUT TO CHANGE. ONCE AND FOR ALL! In Arizona, I built the largest grassroots movement in the history of this nation, and I want to make sure every Arizonan and American gets the opportunity to let their voice be heard. I spent years in the newsroom, looking at the BS & Propaganda the media masters wanted the American people to hear. Now -- I'm kicking this campaign into full gear; we will FIGHT and WIN. At all costs! I have just as much stake in this election as you do; I have two beautiful children and a loving husband. The only thing I want more in the world is for my family to live a life FREE of the government's control and the opportunity to live the American Dream. I've been a fighter all my life. I don't intend to stop now. I'm on a mission for all of US, and I'm fighting for the forgotten people of this nation who've been left behind Washington's narrow-minded agenda. I 'm in this fight for US. We will fight, and we will WIN, by ANY MEANS NECESSARY. Unfortunately, I can't do this alone, I need your help! RUSH YOUR SUPPORT BELOW! JOIN THE BIGGEST GRASSROOTS OPERATION IN AMERICAN HISTORY! Thank you, and GOD BLESS! Kari Lake Candidate for U.S. Senate in Arizona Paid for by Kari Lake for Senate

The best way for me to do my job is by hearing from you. |
#
Hi there! While the headlines coming from the House GOP these past weeks have been nothing short of chaotic, my Democratic colleagues in the Senate and I are hard at work delivering real, tangible results for the American people. That’s why I wanted to touch base with you to hear what’s on your mind and what you want to see my team and I work on. I’ll be focused on protecting reproductive rights from right-wing attacks. I’ll be working to reduce the costs of health care and expand access to all. An August Atlanta Journal Constitution poll* definitively showed us something that appalls us, but doesn’t surprise us: a majority of Georgia Republicans strongly oppose same-sex marriage. In 2023.

In honor of National Coming Out Day, we want to tell you this: the Georgia House Democrats support your right to love - and to live - as you choose. And we will fight to protect that right. As a citizen of Georgia, you deserve it. Unlike the GOP, we do not believe that some people are above others.

If you’re looking for resources for the LGBTQ+ community, try visiting the Georgia branch of The Human Rights Campaign [https://www.hrc.org/resources] or Georgia Equality. [https://georgiaequality.org/about/mission/] Both organizations can help find support for mental health care, health care in general, and even employment opportunities.

As always, stand tall and proud, and know that Georgia House Democrats stand with you.

Onwards,

Georgia House Democrats

*AJC Poll: Georgia Republicans Oppose Gay Marriage, Support Strict Abortion Laws [https://www.ajc.com/politics/ajc-poll-georgia-republicans-oppose-gay-marriage-support-strict-abortion-laws/BSEC7ICGZJBNVMFC75TEWYDJRM/?utm_source=Iterable&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=campaign_7616553]

The Georgia House Democratic Caucus is Georgia’s most diverse group of leaders working on the ground in Georgia every day to flip the State House and secure a blue Georgia. To create the change we need, we’ll need all the help we can get. Will you join the movement for a blue Georgia by donating today?

DONATE TODAY! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gahouse-grassroots2?refcode=101123_ComingOut_button2]

Paid for by Georgia Blue PAC

Georgia House Democratic Caucus
PO Box 18622
Atlanta, GA 31126
United States

---|---|---

| | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: The EPA is set to APPROVE bee-killing pesticides for another 15 years -- but we can still STOP this! ** **Over the last two decades, the populations of critical wild bee species have _PLUMMETED_ : The Rusty-Patched Bumblebee population has dropped by 87%, the American Bumblebee by 89%, and the Western Bumblebee by 93%. ** **Research points to neonics as a leading cause of these massive bee die-offs. The most widely used pesticides in the world, neonics have made agriculture nearly 50 times more toxic to insects. Neonics are _EXTREMELY DEADLY TO BEES._ They attack bees’ nervous systems and can harm their ability to navigate, find food, fight pests and diseases — and even reproduce! ** [**_If we’re going to protect wild bees and other pollinators from being wiped out, we MUST demand an end to the widespread use of bee-killing neonics. Will you take action NOW to help SAVE THE BEES before it’s too late?_**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2044493?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2044494?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Bees are essential for our food chain and way of life. We rely on these helpful little pollinators for **_1 out of 3 bites of food_** that we eat and _**75% of the world’s most nutritious food crops**_ like fruits, veggies, and nuts. Almonds wouldn’t even _EXIST_ if it weren’t for bees! And without bees and other pollinators, crops like coffee and chocolate would be in short supply, making them more expensive and harder to obtain.
But TOXIC bee-killing neonics are threatening critical pollinators and the health of our ecosystems. Recent studies have shown that widespread use of neonics can be harmful to humans — especially children — **even being linked to cancer!**
The EU has already banned the worst neonics, and states like MD and NJ have implemented restrictions on them. **Yet the EPA is still preparing to __APPROVE__ these DANGEROUS pesticides for _ANOTHER 15 years._** Wild bees can’t wait that long, Friend, so we urgently need you to take action with us before it’s too late. [_**Add your name right now to PROTECT POLLINATORS from TOXIC NEONICS! >>**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2044495?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

Friends of the Earth**

name: Team Katie Porter
subject: Cracking down on scam PACs
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Senate
body:
Politics shouldn’t be a get-rich-quick scheme for consultants with no morals or conscience.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=31291%2E3422442%2EU1rCsQ)
Have you heard of scam PACs, Derek?
They’re political action committees that raise money under the pretense of supporting certain causes or candidates, but then spend most or all of the money they raise on “consultants” instead.
**They’re a shameful way to make a quick buck—and Katie introduced a bill to crack down on them.**
Politics shouldn’t be a get-rich-quick scheme for consultants with no morals or conscience. When you donate to a political organization, you should be able to expect that your money will go to supporting the candidates or causes that you intend to support.
Scam PACs are also some of the worst offenders when it comes to some of the more unscrupulous fundraising tactics: Things marked with _“Warning: Payment Incomplete”_ to scare people into donating under false pretenses. Or fundraising appeals that promise your contribution will be _“400% matched”_ when no such match exists.
As a consumer protection attorney, Katie has despised these tactics for a long time. It’s why she’s always insisted that our email program be among the most ethical in politics, and why she introduced legislation to finally crack down on these scammers.

**It is a full-circle moment for EMILYs List that one of our own, our former president, was called upon to serve as a U.S. senator. **Laphonza brings to the Senate a career's worth of leadership and expertise, and Gov. Newsom made an extraordinary choice in appointing her to fill the late Sen. Dianne Feinstein's seat.

By now, we all have seen, read, or heard the news out of Israel.
The USS Gerald R. Ford Carrier Strike Group has been sent to the Eastern Mediterranean. Our largest aircraft carrier and her crew are on duty, accompanied by several cruisers and destroyers.
The Biden administration has confirmed that several Americans were among those captured by Hamas.
And all the while, we have empty seats at the highest levels of our Military.
There is no confirmed Chief of Naval Operations, with Admiral Lisa Franchetti waiting to fill the top seat in the Navy.

More than 300 other seats remain unfilled, critical pieces of the most powerful Military on Earth.

This legislation: reaffirms Israel's right to self defense; condemns Hamas and their actions; urges Hamas to cease their horrific violence, release their hostages, and turn over the bodies of their victims to Israeli authorities; and reaffirms the United States' commitment to Israel through security, diplomatic, and intelligence assistance. I will continue to monitor the situation in Israel, and update you on what Congress is doing to help. Hi Friend,

I'm Alison Esposito, and I'm running for United States Congress in New York's 18th District to bring common sense back to Washington, D.C.

For 25 years, I served my community in the New York City Police Department (NYPD) after following in my father's footsteps. I spent my whole career fighting to keep people safe and deliver results for my community.

[](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=8dbbd97d98c544c99da21e375cee3056&_e=OKj9UMWru2n8qgVt8ZLDFiy2QBzCgxBWDKd_VHy56QrNU6tWNBWMufPeEoGeZ_YuEVGoouWDOHvGFfPSbBwI5oOFLCL4O7J4mCsfL45NeMzo-L5V7i8kna2Fc7v3cwfBeFUeaCrOS0RWHrIk-Zr8n4en6ToH8us1bUXqRfOObJZ69hzWQW648VLpuzRwpU19xNWqvkoQ-CKiyc-mLd0zfzkXmUDf8nczUveSUgWZXdr1QqlvVPMIE4j48FLC8mXPvm8pdxk2-JTLWipJPGHWm12Y8KaemkgrgSqmtLufs9A01T46tRlPkUKy34j70kaL5nN8hnOW1MZvUtCPrlPxGzMapMOQMcvg78M-Md3qyxwBz0eBaOJzHQuneZJS6Oak)
**_But today, I hardly recognize the state and for that matter, the country I grew up in. Crime is rampant, Americans are struggling financially, and criminals have taken over our streets pouring deadly drugs into our communities._**

Worst of all, we are stuck under the leadership of passive and partisan politicians who have failed the people of New York. I never imagined that I would end my career in law enforcement, but after witnessing how elected officials undermined brave officers and law abiding New Yorkers, I knew I had to step up and do more for my community.

[](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=8dbbd97d98c544c99da21e375cee3056&_e=OKj9UMWru2n8qgVt8ZLDFiy2QBzCgxBWDKd_VHy56QrNU6tWNBWMufPeEoGeZ_YuEVGoouWDOHvGFfPSbBwI5oOFLCL4O7J4mCsfL45NeMzo-L5V7i8kna2Fc7v3cwfBeFUeaCrOS0RWHrIk-Zr8n4en6ToH8us1bUXqRfOObJZ69hzWQW648VLpuzRwpU19xNWqvkoQ-CKiyc-mLd0zfzkXmUDf8nczUveSUgWZXdqm32rAlYnV0_tsl2kv-Gejasnt-ncrPaKsnRnPKOV0tUbzO27XDJTMDkBwc_qDN3NQ8rsu_ZsWq32b7O7Zp6sI9WjdwMbauM_BveiCueYE4ajzAefYc7mhNQrCyv3IngE8PlSruFMPwrY04RYuh6mc)
New York's elected officials like Governor Kathy Hochul, Congressman Pat Ryan and New York City Mayor Eric Adams have deemed our counties and state Sanctuary safe spaces and our once quiet and safe communities are inundated with people who have crossed our border illegally.

So one day, I looked at the seat I was sitting in and the hat that I was wearing and I realized I was sitting in the wrong seat and wearing the wrong hat to be able to affect the change that New Yorkers so desperately need. I needed to do more, which is why I left my beloved NYPD to embark on a rescue mission with Congressman Zeldin to Save Our State. After running alongside Lee Zeldin for Lieutenant Governor last year, it's time I return to fight once again. This time, to run for Congress to represent New York's 18th district and end the Washington dysfunction.

[](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=8dbbd97d98c544c99da21e375cee3056&_e=OKj9UMWru2n8qgVt8ZLDFiy2QBzCgxBWDKd_VHy56QrNU6tWNBWMufPeEoGeZ_YuEVGoouWDOHvGFfPSbBwI5oOFLCL4O7J4mCsfL45NeMzo-L5V7i8kna2Fc7v3cwfBeFUeaCrOS0RWHrIk-Zr8n4en6ToH8us1bUXqRfOObJZ69hzWQW648VLpuzRwpU19xNWqvkoQ-CKiyc-mLd0zfzkXmUDf8nczUveSUgWZXdr_dIzsh1-nuhtpvyjPlhJVqebYmmN1kLTVC02Rb4i5jwkJgsErZlaBu7eAVrCC2v2LVkQYJn8NiNBlrny4NiHbdPPKbWZYhbTwMJrx4LLsnGFLmZvDOooU47pFMuYssB0HIBysB61BTw_zEU98op45)
My whole career, I learned how to put differences aside and work together to solve big problems. That's why I'm stepping up to reverse the damage done by partisan politicians and bring the voice of my hometown to Congress.

New York needs capable, determined, and courageous leaders with integrity who will protect everyday New Yorkers, drive down their cost of living, and be their voice in Congress. I pledge to fight against the failed policies of the progressive elected officials who have turned their backs on their constituents and chosen to put Power before People.

[](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=8dbbd97d98c544c99da21e375cee3056&_e=OKj9UMWru2n8qgVt8ZLDFiy2QBzCgxBWDKd_VHy56QrNU6tWNBWMufPeEoGeZ_YuEVGoouWDOHvGFfPSbBwI5oOFLCL4O7J4mCsfL45NeMzo-L5V7i8kna2Fc7v3cwfBeFUeaCrOS0RWHrIk-Zr8n4en6ToH8us1bUXqRfOObJZ69hzWQW648VLpuzRwpU19xNWqvkoQ-CKiyc-mLd0zfzkXmUDf8nczUveSUgWZXdp_FzTMiL5thB0CrCP8OlDsSs-RvBtFsOC_8tnR81pLEWq7nCZ8U_OdVAR8If_le-MWXNEtmXniZ9DPf7S2VkrL7iz_yaT2xMl1T43uNJWXAzfXpvCzGXgMycsS3ltgaET23HqQfuqTARYhKwqQLBkr)
So, Friend, I need to know if you're ready to ride the wave of common sense with me. [**_Will you join my team?_**](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=8dbbd97d98c544c99da21e375cee3056&_e=OKj9UMWru2n8qgVt8ZLDFiy2QBzCgxBWDKd_VHy56QrNU6tWNBWMufPeEoGeZ_YuEVGoouWDOHvGFfPSbBwI5oOFLCL4O7J4mCsfL45NeMzo-L5V7i8kna2Fc7v3cwfBeFUeaCrOS0RWHrIk-Zr8n4en6ToH8us1bUXqRfOObJZ69hzWQW648VLpuzRwpU19xNWqvkoQ-CKiyc-mLd0zfzkXmUDf8nczUveSUgWZXdqDKZ6iMJKWf-DfIY8zxYr-s7akyaBxi7NdGEajqHP5eTvsID0tsnE2WwnRnteXNoTQdmIL8GpmZseNVbEBy_G7GUi5gN29ebjll5tmaM1xzf77_5qzyxVTy3c-LYkBv6yaQ5RLGXgJErPlD0AZYpJ1)

clean_body: Here's why it matters. | Hi Friend, I'm Alison Esposito, and I'm running for United States Congress in New York's 18th District to bring common sense back to Washington, D.C. For 25 years, I served my community in the New York City Police Department (NYPD) after following in my father's footsteps. I spent my whole career fighting to keep people safe and deliver results for my community. But today, I hardly recognize the state and for that matter, the country I grew up in. Crime is rampant, Americans are struggling financially, and criminals have taken over our streets pouring deadly drugs into our communities. Worst of all, we are stuck under the leadership of passive and partisan politicians who have failed the people of New York. I never imagined that I would end my career in law enforcement, but after witnessing how elected officials undermined brave officers and law abiding New Yorkers, I knew I had to step up and do more for my community. New York's elected officials like Governor Kathy Hochul, Congressman Pat Ryan and New York City Mayor Eric Adams have deemed our counties and state Sanctuary safe spaces and our once quiet and safe communities are inundated with people who have crossed our border illegally. So one day, I looked at the seat I was sitting in and the hat that I was wearing and I realized I was sitting in the wrong seat and wearing the wrong hat to be able to affect the change that New Yorkers so desperately need. I needed to do more, which is why I left my beloved NYPD to embark on a rescue mission with Congressman Zeldin to Save Our State. After running alongside Lee Zeldin for Lieutenant Governor last year, it's time I return to fight once again. This time, to run for Congress to represent New York's 18th district and end the Washington dysfunction. My whole career, I learned how to put differences aside and work together to solve big problems. That's why I'm stepping up to reverse the damage done by partisan politicians and bring the voice of my hometown to Congress. New York needs capable, determined, and courageous leaders with integrity who will protect everyday New Yorkers, drive down their cost of living, and be their voice in Congress. I pledge to fight against the failed policies of the progressive elected officials who have turned their backs on their constituents and chosen to put Power before People. So, Friend, I need to know if you're ready to ride the wave of common sense with me. It's time to reclaim our American dream and save our beloved state and country. I truly look forward to working with you. | Sincerely, Alison Esposito Paid for by Esposito for Congress Copyright (C) 2023 Esposito for Congress, All rights reserved.

Help us reach 5,000 comments to overcome corporate polluters.? Tell the EPA:
PROTECT COMMUNITIES FROM CHEMICAL DISASTERS
The EPA is now seeking public input on a new rule to require industrial facilities to disclose the hazardous chemical risks posed by their operations, take stronger actions to prevent accidents, and move quickly should an accident occur.

Corporate polluters have already killed this rule once, when Trump decided to allow these dangerous facilities to operate in secrecy. We cannot allow them to succeed again.

GOAL: 5,000 actions
TAKE ACTION https://links.messages.lcv. ? ?
? Peter ? a critical new rule from Biden's EPA would finally require dangerous industrial facilities to disclose any hazardous chemicals they contain ? and take steps to prevent and mitigate harmful accidents.

This rule will especially protect people living closest to these facilities, which are overwhelmingly low-wealth communities and communities of color, as well as workers. Decades of environmental racism ensured these hazardous facilities were located in the neighborhoods with the least resources to fight back, meaning these frontline communities are disproportionately exposed to chemical accidents and harmful pollutants that have jeopardized their health.

Here's the problem: powerful interests, like the oil and gas industry and the chemical industry, are demanding the EPA once again abandon these important protections. Unless our movement speaks up right now, we may miss out on this opportunity to advance environmental justice and worker safety, and create healthier communities and workplaces.

Please TAKE ACTION right now to protect communities from chemical hazards. To beat the chemical industry, we need to urgently deliver 5,000 comments supporting the EPA's proposed rule. https://links.messages.lcv.

We've already seen the dangers these facilities can pose. In 2013, an explosion of ammonium nitrate fertilizer killed 15 people and destroyed a school, nursing home, and many homes in the city of West, Texas. The Obama administration began a painstaking process to prevent similar disasters, culminating in enhanced protections for minimizing and managing chemical risks.

But after an aggressive campaign from the chemical industry and other corporate polluters, the Trump administration abandoned the rule, choosing to prioritize corporate profits over the health of vulnerable communities and workers.

Under President Biden, the EPA can now reverse this dangerous decision and finally help protect people, especially environmental justice communities, from hazardous pollution and chemical disasters.

Don't let corporate polluters undermine critical environment protections. TAKE ACTION now to help us deliver 5,000 comments supporting environmental justice and corporate accountability. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/-LXrB9yqVeH~

Thank you for taking action to protect people and workers from environmental disasters.

Sincerely,

Madeleine Foote
Deputy Legislative Director

# Courage and Independence
---
|
---
| | |
---
| Fellow Patriots, There are plenty of choices within the presidential field – senators, governors, ambassadors, entrepreneurs. While we all call ourselves Republicans, I am the only candidate with the courage and independence to truly shake things up in Washington. After all, I’m the **ONLY** person in this race who isn’t beholden to special interests, from big business to the political establishment. That frees me up to do what any president should: fight for the interests of the American people. I’ve heard the call to public service, and I’m answering it by running for president. And so many of you have already graciously answered the call to help us meet our crucial mid-month fundraising goal. **_But I’ll be honest: we’re still nearly $78,000 short._** [**We’ve got time to close the gap before this critical deadline. So, I’ll humbly ask you again: can you donate ANY AMOUNT today?**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=7638eef785&e=0be619cbaa) I don’t have to tell you how high the stakes are. You’re living every day with the real-world consequences of an out-of-control Biden Administration. **But with the right leadership, we can restore America and usher in a new Golden Age for this and future generations.** That begins with patriotic Americans like you and I standing up and telling the career politicians in plain English: enough. [**If you’re ready for America First policies and leadership willing to do the tough things necessary to save our great country, please give whatever you can TODAY. $20, $30, $100 – ANY AMOUNT – brings us one step closer to meeting our mid-month goal.**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=0fc7b46c32&e=0be619cbaa) Thank you,
Larry Elder

After all, I’m the ONLY person in this race who isn’t beholden to special interests, from big business to the political establishment. That frees me up to do what any president should: fight for the interests of the American people. I’ve heard the call to public service, and I’m answering it by running for president. And so many of you have already graciously answered the call to help us meet our crucial mid-month fundraising goal. But I’ll be honest: we’re still nearly $78,000 short. I don’t have to tell you how high the stakes are. You’re living every day with the real-world consequences of an out-of-control Biden Administration. But with the right leadership, we can restore America and usher in a new Golden Age for this and future generations. That begins with patriotic Americans like you and I standing up and telling the career politicians in plain English: enough. clean_body: For Peter | | | We have a BIG elections update for you! As you may be aware, Georgia has municipal elections all across the state on November 7th, 2023. Ahead of the 2024 presidential election, we need to ensure that every Democrat in Georgia is fired up and ready to turn out to vote. Voting is a habit, and every voter we turn out to vote this year is exponentially more likely to show up to vote for Joe Biden in 2024. Not only that, but these elections have a huge impact on local policies. The most extreme wing of the GOP has turned our classrooms into battlefields, and they’re working hard to flip control of school boards across the country. We need to fight back and elect school board members and local leaders who will put people over politics. That means turning out voters this November. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = = = = = = Municipal elections are often overlooked and don’t receive the national attention of elections involving the Presidency or U.S. Senate, but they’re critically important for Georgia children and communities, and we need to defeat the extreme MAGA Republicans who want to ban books and silence teachers. = Thank you for your support, GA Dems | | Paid for by the Democratic Party of Georgia. Peter,

Today is National Coming Out Day and in honor of this occasion, I want to be vulnerable with you for a moment and share my personal painful story about my coming out experience.

**In 1994, my Republican opponent outed me as gay with bigoted and homophobic ads to our district. I hadn’t even come out publicly yet!**

For members of the LGBTQ+ community, coming out is an extremely personal and sensitive moment. So, you can imagine my horror and heartbreak upon finding out I had been outed so publicly in such a hateful way. I was crushed.

**I ended up losing that extremely competitive race and it wasn’t until 18 years later that I finally won my race for Congress in 2012.**

Peter, I’m so glad that in the face of such discriminatory attacks, I didn’t give up.

Now, I can fight for LGBTQ+ equality and dignity in our nation’s capital and stand up for other marginalized Americans.

But sadly, since 2012, Republican bigotry and vitriol has not slowed down. Trump’s MAGA Republicans have spread hatred and divisiveness around the world while Republican state legislatures are passing anti‐LGBTQ+ legislation as fast as they can. clean_body: my story: | = Peter, Today is National Coming Out Day and in honor of this occasion, I want to be vulnerable with you for a moment and share my personal painful story about my coming out experience. In 1994, my Republican opponent outed me as gay with bigoted and homophobic ads to our district. I hadn’t even come out publicly yet! For members of the LGBTQ+ community, coming out is an extremely personal and sensitive moment. So, you can imagine my horror and heartbreak upon finding out I had been outed so publicly in such a hateful way. I was crushed. I ended up losing that extremely competitive race and it wasn’t until 18 years later that I finally won my race for Congress in 2012. Peter, I’m so glad that in the face of such discriminatory attacks, I didn’t give up. Now, I can fight for LGBTQ+ equality and dignity in our nation’s capital and stand up for other marginalized Americans. But sadly, since 2012, Republican bigotry and vitriol has not slowed down. clean_body: | | | Peter, Since the overturning of Roe v. Wade last year, every state in the South has passed laws to ban abortion — all except Virginia, where we have a crucial opportunity to take back power from Republicans and protect abortion access this year. With newly drawn districts and every seat in the legislature up for election, we can win back the State House, defend and expand our majority in the State Senate, and build the foundation to defeat Donald Trump and Republican Governor Glenn Youngkin in the next two years. So today, we’re proud to announce our first round of Virginia endorsements for the general election, candidates who will fight for abortion justice, reform our criminal justice system, secure good jobs and higher wages for workers, and stand up to abusive utility monopolies. During Virginia’s primary season this year, supporters like you helped knock on 32,000 doors, make 120,000 phone calls, send 1 million texts, deliver 200,000 mailers, and reach over 2 million voters with digital ads. Thanks to those efforts, we saw bold WFP candidates achieve victory across the state, winning eight legislative races and defending three progressive reformer district attorneys. Now, we’re facing off against MAGA Republicans who will ban abortion if they’re allowed to win a trifecta next month. And we’re throwing down to elect leaders who can kick the GOP out of power. Meet the Working Families Party Virginia 2023 slate: Danica Roem for State Senate District 30 Nadarius Clark for State House District 84 Joshua Thomas for State House District 21 Travis Nembhard for State House District 22 Joshua Cole for State House District 65 Buta Biberaj for Loudoun County Commonwealth’s Attorney Craig Buckley for Loudoun County Sheriff Deshundra Jefferson for Prince William County Board Chairmanship Idris O' Connor for Prince William County District Supervisor (Coles District) Josh King for Prince William County Sheriff The last few years have shown us just how close Virginia elections can be, with Democrats winning the State House in 2017 by a literal coin toss. We can’t afford to leave anything up to chance this year — these champions need our support to beat the far right. And because Virginia has no contribution limits on political spending, we need to work even harder to combat big money from companies like Dominion Energy who are determined to maintain their exploitative monopoly in the state. [1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Cori Bush and Rashida Tlaib are under attack from the White House for
calling for a ceasefire from both Palestine and Israel to prevent the
further loss of innocent Palestinian and Israeli life, instead of beating
the drums of war and pledging unwavering support for further escalation by
the Israeli military.

“The White House said Tuesday that statements from members of Congress
calling for a ceasefire in Israel instead of issuing their full support
for the country, following the surprise attack by Hamas, are ‘wrong’ and
disgraceful.’” — The Hill

Cori and Rashida are both showing political courage by calling for an
immediate ceasefire and being some of the few leaders truthful enough to
call out Israel–alongside Hamas–for its war crimes against civilians. But
we are seeing them face severe attacks from both fellow Democrats and
Republicans for taking this stance.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/138837?refcode=em20231011-31279&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=31279%2E1203867%2EvFak8W ]It is crucial that we have the resources to support and re-elect both
Rashida Tlaib and Cori Bush this cycle. Peter,
will you rush a $3
contribution right now to help us prepare for these attacks?

The White House and Congress have already begun warning us of their
intention to escalate this violence with further funding for the Israeli
military. If we continue to send unconditional funding to the Israeli
military, we are greenlighting the far-right Israeli government’s calls
for the ethnic cleansing of two million Palestinians in Gaza.

Our government’s complicity with decades of human rights abuses and
international law violations cannot be understated. There is blood on the
hands of the American government.

We know that a path towards peace does not begin with funding further
military violence and occupation that provoked this crisis. Congresswomen
Cori Bush and Rashida Tlaib know this too and aren’t afraid to speak truth
to power.

In 2024, it is so important that we re-elect unwavering pro-peace leaders
who are committed to defending the human rights of all people equally like
Rashida, Cori, and the entire Squad. We have to protect the progress we
have made to elect progressive champions who aren’t afraid of taking
politically difficult stances.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/138837?refcode=em20231011-31279&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=31279%2E1203867%2EvFak8W ]Please contribute $3 right now to ensure we have the
resources to protect and support Rashida and Cori while they endure
attacks from every part of the political establishment.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/138837?refcode=em20231011-31279&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=31279%2E1203867%2EvFak8W ]Contribute $3

Thank you for your solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY POWERED BY PEOPLE
body:
[1]Powered By People

Greg Abbott brought Texas legislators back to the Capitol this week to try
to pass a billionaire-backed voucher scam that would defund public schools
to subsidize private education for the wealthy.

Here’s what you need to know, and how you can fight back.

Vouchers pose an existential threat to our public schools.

Texas already ranks 43rd in the nation for public school funding. Vouchers
would take even more money out of our kids’ classrooms to give what
essentially amounts to a tax break for wealthy parents who send their
children to private schools.

As State Representative Gina Hinojosa put it, “vouchers are welfare for
the well-off.”

Just look at what’s happened in states that have vouchers. In New
Hampshire, 89% of vouchers have gone to students already in private
schools. In Arizona, over HALF of the new education spending in the
state’s 2024 budget will go to vouchers that benefit only 8% of students.

The result? Kids whose parents can’t afford a private education are left
in public schools with even larger class sizes, even lower teacher pay,
and even fewer extracurriculars. Teachers get laid off. Some schools
consolidate or close altogether.

Texas Democrats need our help fighting Abbott’s voucher scam.

Right-wing billionaires are bankrolling Abbott’s voucher fight. They’re
donating millions to pro-voucher candidates and spending big on
billboards, TV buys, and digital ads to campaign against lawmakers who
oppose them.

This is their thinking: If they don’t win during this legislative session,
they’ll use their money to replace voucher opponents in 2024 so that they
can win in the next one.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20231011.5BANet&refcode=ema20231011-233222&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=233222%2E444211%2Ev35G5f ]That means Texas Democrats—who stand united against vouchers—need our
help. So please join me in making a donation today so that we can stand a
fighting chance against these billionaires and support the Democrats
leading this fight.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20231011.5BANet&refcode=ema20231011-233222&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=233222%2E444211%2Ev35G5f ]Contribute $3

Your support will help Powered by People organize, register, and mobilize
the voters we need to defend these Democratic lawmakers in their next
election and elect more leaders who will stand up for our kids, our
parents, and our teachers.

Thanks for being in this fight.

— Beto

It's National Coming Out Day, friend!

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_shyne?refcode=231011_ss_coming_out_img [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_shyne?refcode=231011_ss_coming_out_img]

I am a lesbian. I'm so proud to live every day as my open and authentic self. But like many queer people — and especially queer children of immigrants — my journey to where I am today wasn't always straightforward.

For many years — even after coming to the United States — I pretended to be straight just to fit in.

I finally came out to a few close friends in high school and to my mother when I was 19.

There were fewer resources for queer kids back then, and fewer places to find safety, acceptance, and community. I remember being kicked out of my favorite coffee shop by a police officer, just for holding hands with my girlfriend.

But these experiences made me who I am today. They inspired me to go to law school and dedicate my life to the fight for civil rights. And today, I'm so thankful for my friends, family and community who accept and support me for who I am. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_shyne?refcode=231011_ss_coming_out_l1]

Contribute [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_shyne?refcode=231011_ss_coming_out_b1]

So no matter your coming out journey, I am here as proof that we are building a more caring, more tolerant, more loving world every day. I'm so thankful to have you with me, friend.

With gratitude,

clean_body: [] It's National Coming Out Day, friend! [] I am a lesbian. I'm so proud to live every day as my open and authentic self. But like many queer people — and especially queer children of immigrants — my journey to where I am today wasn't always straightforward. For many years — even after coming to the United States — I pretended to be straight just to fit in. I finally came out to a few close friends in high school and to my mother when I was 19. There were fewer resources for queer kids back then, and fewer places to find safety, acceptance, and community. I remember being kicked out of my favorite coffee shop by a police officer, just for holding hands with my girlfriend. But these experiences made me who I am today. They inspired me to go to law school and dedicate my life to the fight for civil rights. And today, I'm so thankful for my friends, family and community who accept and support me for who I am. I admired her desire to serve our great state then, as I do now. BUT, there is only one proven conservative winner that is running for the U.S. Senate, and that is me. I am a lifelong conservative who has dedicated my life to protecting Arizonans and keeping them safe when Democrat policies make that job almost impossible. I have been in Arizona fighting for the people that call this great state home. I’m not a talker, I’m a doer, and I win elections. That is what separates me from my opponents. The Senate race in Arizona is going to be the most expensive, most watched Senate race of the 2024 cycle. Already, forecasters are predicting more than $800 MILLION in spending to influence the results. I can and will win this race for the Republican Party. Today, . body:
The right wing would love nothing more than to silence the voices of two strong, progressive, Black women who have committed their lives to fighting for justice
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=605%2E791427%2EU_q5bY)

Friends-
I'm writing today to urgently ask you to **[split a contribution — of $3 or anything you can — between our re-election campaign and my friend Summer Lee.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-oct23-summer-split.k2LVtr&refcode=em231011-1-t4&t=2&akid=605%2E791427%2EU_q5bY)**
