---
****
Here's why:
Even before her historic election to Congress in 2022, Summer has always taken on big fights with wealthy and powerful special interests who put profits over the lives of working people.
One of the consequences of doing that — as our movement knows all too well — is that they have a tremendous amount of resources at their disposal to fight back with.
Right-wing super PACs have spent _millions_ of dollars last cycle trying to defeat progressives across the country, including me and Summer.
In many cases, it worked. And for the two of us, it was too close for comfort.
We already know that these same groups are gearing up for 2024, and that Summer and I are two of the right wing's top-priority targets in all of Congress.
**The simple truth is that they'd love nothing more than to silence the voices of two strong, progressive, Black women who have committed their lives to fighting for justice.**
They've already begun recruiting establishment challengers to primary us, and it won't be long before bigoted, dark money-funded attack ads are blanketing the airwaves in Minneapolis and Pittsburgh.
The billionaires who fund these attacks are the same ones who didn't spend a dime helping _any_ Democrats get elected in 2022, instead bankrolling luxury vacations for Supreme Court justices who dismantled reproductive rights, affirmative action, and student debt forgiveness.
It's absolutely critical that all of us stand together and fight back as soon as we can. Because together is the only way we can defeat them again.
**Summer Lee is an essential ally in our progressive movement's collective struggle, so please:**
**[Can you split a contribution — of $3 or anything you can — between my campaign and Summer Lee's today? Both of us need to have the resources to fight back against the billionaires and their super PACs in 2024, and your support is the only way we can do that.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-oct23-summer-split.k2LVtr&refcode=em231011-1-t4&t=27&akid=605%2E791427%2EU_q5bY)**
I know that I can speak for both Summer and myself when I say thank you for being a part of our movement. It means so much to know that we can count on you when it matters most.
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar

Dear Patriot,

Like me, I know you are horrified at the Hamas terror group's barbaric actions over the weekend. The pictures of Jewish women, children, and infants slaughtered by these monsters are without parallel since World War 2. **_I enlisted in the United States Navy just after 9/11 and served during our war on terror. There is no room in a civilized society for terrorist organizations like Hamas._**

I stand strongly in support of Israel as I have with the Armenian people who faced brutal attacks in Artsakh simply because of their religion and ethnicity. There is no justification or place in a civilized world for what has occurred in either country. Terrorists must be hunted and eliminated. Former President Ronald Reagan once warned these thugs, "You can run, but you can't hide."

**_As a former FBI Special Agent, I am keenly aware of these terrorist threats. We should be concerned. For years, our government has allowed thousands of illegal border crossers from Middle Eastern countries to slip into our country._****_It is almost certain that Hamas and Hezbollah members are hiding out in the United States._**

This **MUST** end. We **HAVE TO ELIMINATE** these threats.

That's why I am running for Congress against far-leftist Jim Costa. Costa has backed Joe Biden's dangerous border policy and made America weaker. His lack of action has endangered lives here in the Central Valley.

I believe protecting our homeland is one of the crucial jobs you elect Congress to do, and that begins by closing down our border to the terrorists and ENDING the Biden border policy.

If you agree and want to help our campaign, [chip into my campaign](https://michaelmaher.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6239b7d9cb3ad9388556be8be&id=377b6e4253&e=1722d05e10) \-- a campaign that will fight against the terrorists' hate and ideology and stand up to terrorist apologists.

body:
Here is the truth:
#

In just a minute, I am going to ask you to make a contribution to my campaign for United States Senate in Arizona. PLEASE give me a chance to explain why this request -- especially today -- is so important.
Here is the truth:
Last night, Kari Lake announced she is running for United States Senate in Arizona.
She'll start her campaign with the support of the entire Trump-right and even some rich Republicans who may not like her, but want to see Republicans take control of the Senate.
Now, I hear a lot of people say "Kari Lake can never win." Please know that's false. She lost her last statewide campaign in Arizona by less than 1%.
And given the uncertainty Kyrsten Sinema's involvement adds to the race, anything can happen.
Polling shows we hold a slight lead in this race. We can win this seat for Democrats, and help us keep control of the Senate.
But I can't do it without you. We are going to face wild and expensive attacks.
I know you probably didn't wake up this morning, shoot out of bed and race to your computer thinking "I can't wait to contribute to Ruben Gallego's campaign today."
But I hope you will. The outcome of Arizona's Senate race, and control of the United States Senate depends on it.
[**Please use this link to contribute $3, or whatever you can afford today, directly to my campaign for United States Senate in Arizona. name: Wes Moore
subject: Extremism hiding in plain sight
body:
Friend, I love this country.

I fought for this country overseas.

And I will continue to fight for this country as Maryland’s Governor.

So I refuse to let MAGA politicians claim the mantle of “patriotism” — not when their extremism hides in plain sight.

I’ll explain exactly what I mean — but first, if you’re with us, I’ve got to ask for your support. We’re redefining patriotism and bringing people together in Maryland, and we need you on our team. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20231011-1?refcode=em20231011-1]

Friend, I’m talking about MAGA guys like Steve Scalise, who Republicans nominated today to replace Kevin McCarthy as the Speaker of the House. Scalise once described himself as “David Duke without the baggage” — and even attended a white supremacist conference organized by Duke in 2022.

I’m talking about my former opponent for Governor of Maryland — a man who accepted a gift from a Proud Boys member and helped bus insurrectionists to the Capitol on January 6.

I’m talking about all the other MAGA politicians across the country and up and down the ballot who STILL deny the results of the 2020 presidential election.
These folks say that THEY’RE the patriots!

No, friend.

We’re not going to let the people who would destroy our freedoms claim they’re the ones defending them.

Here’s how I define patriotism:

Patriotism is the service of the brave men and women in our military, including those I served with in the 82nd Airborne Division.

Patriotism looks like the ministers and schoolteachers and operating engineers, in my family and across Maryland, who helped build this country to what it is today.

And patriotism is the work we’re doing right now, to build a state government that actually works to improve Marylanders’ lives.

So MAGA politicians can wave around a flag all they want. But I will not be lectured about patriotism by insurrectionists, extremists, or anyone who supports white supremacists.

Elevate,

Wes

P.S. Help Maryland keep leading the way. Chip in anything today to support our administration. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20231011-1?refcode=em20231011-1]
